articleTitle: Clock Compensation Two-Way Ranging (CC-TWR) Based on Ultra-Wideband Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: High accuracy and precision of positioning in Ultra-Wideband (UWB) localization system depends on the quality of clock oscillators, which influences system performance. This is a very common method of measuring the distance from the target to the reference node by two-way range (TWR) or symmetric double-sided two-way ranging (SDS-TWR), and then obtaining a 2D or 3D coordinate through the relevant algorithm. However, these methods may not meet the high accuracy or real-time requirements of the occasion. This paper presents a new way named CC-TWR based on TWR and clock compensation which can effectively reduce the influence of clock error (clock drift and frequency drift). UWB Ranging System was implemented and tested in static and dynamic practical cases based on DW1000 chip. The effects of clock errors measured by this CC-TWR way greatly is small than the traditional way from the experimental results. At the same time, CC-TWR also has the same high refresh rate as TWR.

articleTitle: An Improved KNN Algorithm for Text Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Among the many text classification algorithms based on vector space model, the effect of KNN(K-Nearest Neighbor) classifier is outstanding. For KNN classification algorithm, calculating the similarity between documents will directly affect the selections of K neighbors, which greatly affects the classification effect. However, the traditional KNN text classification is too rough to calculate text similarity, ignoring the relations within the document and the relationships between the documents. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved KNN algorithm, which calculates similarity by considering the interaction and coupling relationship between the document internal and the document. Theoretical analysis and experiments show that the improved algorithm can overcome the shortcomings of the previous algorithms and improve the accuracy of the KNN text classification.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Detection in Haze Environments Using Dark Channel Prior and Histogram of Oriented Gradient
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Pedestrian detection is a critical requirement for industry computer vision systems and has great research value. Many techniques have been proposed, and one of the most effective methods is based on the Histogram of Oriented Gradient (HOG) descriptor and the Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier. While this method implicitly assumes that the input images are taken in haze-free environments. In this paper, we propose a new method that is capable of handling pedestrian detection in haze environments. Firstly, a haze version of 'INRIA' data set is synthesized based on the natural light transport model. Secondly, robust HOG descriptors are calculated by a fusion model which relies on the dark channel prior haze removal method. At last, a linear SVM classifier is trained for pedestrian detection. The proposed method outperforms the traditional HOG pedestrian detection method on the haze version of 'INRIA' data set.

articleTitle: ICMP NetFlow Records Based Packet Loss Rate Estimation
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Since introduced by Cisco in 2004, NetFlow plays a more and more important role in network measurement. In this paper, we introduce a flow-based passive measurement method, using bidirectional NetFlow records data to estimate network packet loss. We tested the algorithm in real environment and found that the effect of the algorithm has exceeded our expectations.

articleTitle: An End-to-End Detection Method for WebShell with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, a generic static end-to-end detection framework with deep neural network for WebShell is designed, which is free from human labor and domain knowledge. In this paper, we simultaneously introduce word embedding in Natural Language Processing(NLP) and lexical analysis in Programming Language Processing(PLP) to obtain an accurate, structured, semantic-rich vector representation of the script code. For the obtaining's sake, a series of effective tricks are designed to further dig out the high-value information in the script while filtering noise. Then, we provide a desirable algorithm to down-sampling, which drastically reduces the computational costs at a relatively small information loss. Finally, we achieve high detection accuracy by employing the Deep Neural Network (DNN) composed of LSTM and pooling layers. The framework has a significant advantage at least on data set of the experiment.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Walker Constellation for Multi-Target Rapid Revisit
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: To design a Walker constellation for multi-target rapid revisit, a method using optimization is proposed. A constellation optimization design framework is established including optimization algorithm module, simulation condition generation module, simulation module and data analysis module. Select the parameters of the Walker constellation as the optimal variables, formulating optimal objective function considering the system cost and revisit time, full coverage of targets and 1 hour revisit of all targets are used as constraints and optimize the design of constellation using genetic algorithm. The reliability of the method is verified by a practical engineering case at the end of paper. The result show that the Walker constellation designed by this method can achieve the Belt and Road national capitals full coverage and less than 1 hour revisit, have a good application value.

articleTitle: Feature Selection Methods in the Framework of mRMR
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Feature selection (FS) plays an important role in machine learning. FS under minimum redundancy maximum relevance framework based on mutual information behaved well according to existing researched. This paper focus on the validity of the Min-Redundancy Max-Relevance (mRMR) framework with some traditional correlative criteria, such as Spearman coefficient, distance correlation (dCor), and maximal information coefficient (MIC), etc. Experimental results show that mRMR can bring encouraging feature selection result compared with the traditional K-BEST feature selection method, no matter which criterion is adopted and the classification accuracy of these criteria is improved under the mRMR framework.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network Design for Enabling Relay Selection by Supervised Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Our recent work has proved the effectiveness of utilizing supervised machine learning to perform relay selection in cooperative networks. However, the structure of artificial neural network provided is rather heuristic and simple, where a symmetric architecture is adopted with only a single hidden layer and the number of neurons in the hidden layer is the same as the number of inputs/outputs. However, there is not a generalized design guideline for the structure of artificial neural network. In this paper, we thereby investigate the structure related issues for the artificial neural network designed for enabling relay selection by supervised machine learning and test a series of network structures from the very simple one to the multi-layer one. Finally, numerical results generated by Monte Carlo methods are shown to reflect the key findings and a number of crucial features of the proposed artificial neural network in this paper.

articleTitle: A Gravitational Artificial Bee Colony Optimization Algorithm and Application
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel Gravitational Artificial Bee Colony (GABC) optimization algorithm was proposed and utilized to the non-supervised pattern recognition problems. In this approach, the gravitational search strategy was introduced into the artificial bee colony algorithm, and a gravitational bee colony was established. The gravitational bee could search the global optimal result under the influence of both gravitational force and colony cooperation, which makes the optimization process more effectively and efficiently. Based on GABC algorithm, an intelligent kernel clustering model was established, in which the clustering center and kernel parameters were combined to be the optimal variable, while the clustering index was used as the objective function. GABC was utilized to find the optimal result of the clustering model. The standard testing functions were used to test the proposed algorithm, and GABC showed high accuracy and convergence speed. Then the testing data and fault samples were utilized to test the performance of GABC based clustering model, and its superiority on effectiveness and efficiency was demonstrated.

articleTitle: A Reverse Engineering-Based Framework Assisting Hardware Trojan Detection for Encrypted IPs
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Most Intellectual Property (IP) cores in Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) designs are from untrusted third-party IPs (3PIPs) vendors, who may insert hardware trojans into them maliciously. Existing techniques for detecting trojans in 3PIPs mainly focus on unencrypted IP cores. Nevertheless, more and more IP designs are encrypted to protect their details from unauthorized access. In this paper, we propose a new method to crack encrypted IP cores in FPGAs by using reverse engineering techniques for assisting hardware trojan detection, and we optimize the reversing process to enhance its efficiency. To evaluate the performance of our method, we perform two experiments on Xilinx official encrypted IP cores. From the experimental results, we can find that our method can accurately crack various encrypted IP cores. Besides, the time consumption of optimized method is linear to the scale of target IP design, and has diminished 99% compared to the time cost of non-optimized method.

articleTitle: A Template Matching Based Method for Surface-Mount Rectangular-Pin-Chip Positioning and Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper is concerned about the template matching-based rectangular-pin-chip positioning and defect detection problem and a precise efficient universal algorithm of coarse and fine positioning is proposed. In this paper, rectangular-pin-chip is defined as the chips with the package types of SOP, SOJ, PLCC, SOT and so on. In coarse positioning step, the model and edge feature are proposed to get the rough correspondence and correct correspondence. According to the rough location, least square method and template matching are applied to obtain the accurate center coordinate and angle. Then the defect detection is worked out by the duty cycle of template. The experiment on several real-time rectangular-pin-chip positioning shows the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Malware Classification with Markov Transition Field Encoded Images
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Malicious software (Malware) has been growing exponentially recently. And it is urgently need to identify Malware from normal software. As Malware samples can be represented as byteplot grayscale images. Thus, deep transfer learning is a proper method for Malware images classification. However, the Malware samples do not possess the vertical direction structure as image. It is more like one dimensional signal and we can convert Malware to a Malware signal. Thus, we try to extract some feature vector from Malware signal. Then we can use SVM to train a model to detect Malware file. Recently, Markov Transition Field (MTF) can encode time series as images for visual inspection and classification. We can try to adapt MTF to encode the Malware signal to MTF image. Then we reshape MTF as a one-dimensional vector for SVM to train a model. Our proposed method is better than the byteplot grayscale image based method in our dataset. And our proposed MTF based two classes Malware detection method can be used for Malware software detection in reality.

articleTitle: Grayscale Projection Image Stabilization Algorithm Based on Gray Bit-Plane for Moving Object
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In the process of study electronic image stabilization based on gray projection algorithm, it is found that the image stabilization result is inaccurate when the moving object appears in the target image. In order to solve this problem, a new method is proposed. First, an image is divided into eight different gray bit-planes, and then each gray bit-plane for gray projection image stabilization algorithm processing. It is found that the high gray bit-plane can effectively weaken the influence of the moving object on the gray projection algorithm. This can make the calculation more accurate. Experiments show that this proposed method can make the calculation results more accurate.

articleTitle: A Real-Time R-Wave Detection Based on Self-Adaptive Differential Threshold Method
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: R-wave detection is a fundamental step for analyzing and recognizing electrocardiogram (ECG). This paper proposes a real-time R-wave detection method based on self-adaptive differential threshold method. The proposed method is improved based on the traditional differential threshold method. The traditional differential threshold method is to determine the location of R-wave by judging whether the value of the difference of the signal exceeds fixed threshold. We adapt self-adaptive threshold in our paper. Firstly, the ECG signal is differential and square wave is identified. Secondly, threshold is initialized and adjusted, and threshold adjustment consists of two aspects, i.e. amplitude threshold and time threshold. The algorithm can automatically adjust thresholds to adapt to such ECG changes as QRS morphology and heart rate. The ECG data collected by the hardware device were used as a validation set to evaluate the performance of the detection. The experimental result shows average accuracy can reach 99.85%.

articleTitle: SRADR: Network Status and Reputation Adaptive QoS Dynamic Routing for Satellite Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Satellite network has the advantage of global coverage and simple access, so it is considered to be an important part of next generation Internet. In addition, the satellite network has the characteristics of high dynamic topology, limited node processing capacity and high security requirements. Therefore, it is different from the ground Internet. In this paper, we propose a network status and reputation adaptive QoS dynamic routing algorithm for satellite networks, which is called SRADR. It uses ant colony algorithm for routing discovery and dynamic update maintenance according to the network state and the reputation value of nodes as the basis, which makes the selected path a comprehensive performance state and a better security path. Based on the characteristics of the satellite network, the algorithm improves and optimizes the heuristic algorithm from the global perspective, so that the algorithm can adapt to the satellite network environment better. In the end, the performances of end-to-end QoS status and delay are evaluated by simulations.

articleTitle: VLSI Circuit Measurement System Analysis Based on Random Fuzzy Variables
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Data variation is one way of representing the test quality of very large scale integration(VLSI) circuits using automatic test equipment(ATE), especially by the quantitative parameters. Deep submicron integration may cause difference of IC products increase. In order to prevent part variation induced analysis accuracy drop, test fixture, test board and test program are combined and crossly designed with the three-way ANOVA is studied, instead of common operator factor. Based on the 3-way model, with triangular fuzzy number as input and trapezoidal fuzzy number as output, the MSA indices are calculated and verified by a typical memory test.

articleTitle: Research on Influence and Charging Control Strategies of Electric Vehicles Integration into Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: As the energy crisis and environmental pollution is becoming increasingly serious, clean energy is widely promoted, energy conservation and emission reduction is imperative. The development and application of electric vehicles has become an inevitable trend, but the charging of large-scale electric vehicles will have a far-reaching influence on the operation of power system. The factors that affect the charging of electric vehicles were introduced in this paper. Additionally, the effects of electric vehicle charging on power grid operation were analyzed. Finally, the research ideas and priorities of charging control strategies of electric vehicles were analyzed and summarized, which would provide an effective theoretical guidance for the control strategy research on electric vehicles.

articleTitle: An Improved Native Bayes Classifier for Imbalanced Text Categorization Based on K-Means and Chi-Square Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In multiclass text classification, the performance of classifier is usually very low while the data distribution is very uneven. The reason may be that the majority class has a great influence on classifier, and the minority class ignored. This study attempts to solve this problem by improving CHI-square feature selection algorithm and by improving the Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) weight algorithm and combining with the K-means clustering method, generating minority class samples to reduce the influence of inclined class distribution. The experimental results demonstrate that the improved method has a significant improvement on the classification efficiency on the bias dataset.

articleTitle: Current and Future Research of Machine Learning Based Vulnerability Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The quantity and volume of software increase rapidly, more vulnerabilities are hidden there, and thus vulnerability detection becomes more important. This paper reviews works about machine learning based vulnerability detection methods for source code, especially on program representation and vectorization, and Machine Learning based Methods. However, current machine learning methods detect vulnerabilities in coarse-grained level, and locating the vulnerabilities still needs much additional work. This problem can be solved by vulnerability detection in fine-grained level. This paper assumes that vulnerability detection in fine-grained level will be a future research trend, and proposes several possible solutions.

articleTitle: Design of Distributed Remote Data Monitoring System Based on CAN Bus
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Aiming at real-time temperature detection and data upload of mining equipment, a distributed remote data monitoring system based on CAN bus is designed. Using the microcontroller STM32, CAN transceiver TJA1050, K-type thermocouple as the intelligent node for on-site temperature acquisition, the data of multiple intelligent nodes is centralized to the control board through the CAN bus network. The control board displays the data on the LCD and transmits it to the database remotely via Ethernet or GPRS.

articleTitle: Optical Path Scanning Control System Based on Repetitive Control and PI Control
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to obtain fine spectra with high resolution and accuracy, the large optical path difference and the stable optical path reciprocal scanning modulation are necessary in a spectrum detection system. According to scanning characteristics, a mathematical model of the permanent magnet synchronous motor is established. Considering the long path length, rapid commutation, and high speed stability, this paper develops a speed feedback loop and a position feedback loop with PI controller. As the PI controller produces periodic error when tracking periodic signals and reduces the rate stability, a modified repetitive control (MRC) method is studied. The simulation results show that the proposed method can achieve uniform scanning of the optical path difference, and has a good ability to suppress sliding friction.

articleTitle: A New Compensating Method of Non-Ideal Lowpass Filters in Modulated Wideband Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: There are several non-ideal factors in the hardware implementation of Modulated Wideband Converter (MWC), which is an efficient sub-Nyquist system for sampling the sparse multiband signals. The non-ideal lowpass filter is one of these factors and can distort the reconstructed signal. In this paper, we concentrate on how to eliminate the impact of non-ideal lowpass filters and propose a new compensating method which can correct the non-ideal characteristic of actual lowpass filters. This solution remedies for the Fourier coefficients of samples in frequency domain with a bit more oversampling, compared to the standard MWC. The direct compensation in frequency domain is intuitive to acquire the Fourier compensating coefficients. And numerical simulations demonstrate that, this method can compensate many kinds of lowpass filter no matter what radical fluctuations and non-linear phases in the pass band of the filter.

articleTitle: A Portable Facility Developed for Radar Testing Based on ZYNQ
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With the update and improvements of radar technology, radar testing has gained wider and higher demand. Radar testing facilities are developing towards miniaturization and high real time. The emergence of ZYNQ, which is a kind of all programmable SoC designed by Xilinx, allows us to design a portable radar testing facility with high performance based on it. ZYNQ is composed of two parts, the processing system (PS) based on ARM Cortex-A9 and the programmable logic (PL) based on Xilinx FPGA, convenient for building a freely customizable embedded system platform. This paper presents a portable facility developed for radar testing based on ZYNQ. The Radar testing system is a small-sized independent work platform, and results show that the facility can realize the transmission, calculation, storage and display of radar testing data in a 5 ms/10 ms cycle.

articleTitle: The Influence of NAND Flash Self-Recovery Effect on Retention Error
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper verifies the self-recovery effect of NAND flash by experiments and proposes the concept of relaxation time (t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub>) based on self-recovery effect. Moreover, the change rule of data retention error under different degrees of self-recovery effect for blocks with different program/erase stresses is also studied. First of all, the growth trend of NAND flash storage data retention error is significantly reduced by increasing the t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> value. Experiments show that when t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> is 6h, the retention error is reduced by about 60% compared with the retention error under 0h's t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> at the same retention days. In addition, as tr increases, the NAND flash self-recovery effect will reach saturation. The experimental results show that when t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> is around 2h, increasing t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> will not play a significant role in reducing retention error.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Large Delay Wireless Network Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The wireless sensor and actuator network connects the sensor and the actuator to the controller via a wireless network to form a bilateral wireless network control system. The simulation model of the system is given for the adverse effects of wireless network transmission and the delay of the controlled object. The conventional PID control and fuzzy PID control algorithm are used to simulate the controller nodes. The simulation results show that the fuzzy PID control can achieve better control effect and robustness to the wireless network control system with large delay. The research has some reference value for the design of wireless network control system.

articleTitle: Pressurizer Water Level Reconstruction for Nuclear Power Plant Based on GRU
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Pressurizer water level is a vital parameter for marine pressurized water reactors (PWR). Operators use it as key evidence to comprehend reactors' operating conditions and identify their transients. Aiming at problems such as false water level and water level depression due to measurement faults, this paper applied deep learning techniques to the reconstruction on nuclear facilities' parameters. Considering the timing features of PWR operation, a reconstruction model for pressurizer water level were developed upon Gated Recurrent Unit(GRU) recurrent neural network theory. Six parameters highly coupled with pressurizer water level, including the average temperatures of reactor inlet and outlet, the pressure and temperature of pressurizer, the main coolant flow in primary circuit and reactor power, were selected as characteristic input parameters for the reconstruction model. By collecting the operating data of a marine PWR simulator whose reactor power transiently increased from 30% to 90%, the reconstructive pressurizer water levels were tested. The findings showed that the Mean Absolute Error(MAE) resulted from the GRU reconstruction model 0.003345. Compared with BP neural network models, the GRU model was not only able to more accurately approximate the true water level value, but also demonstrated better robustness, stability and convergence rate.

articleTitle: Communication System Fast Reconstruction Strategy and Efficiency Simulation Based on Micro-Nano Satellites
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Micro-nano satellites have the advantages of fast development, low cost and flexible application. With the deployment of communication payloads and constellation design optimization, micro-nano satellites can achieve full coverage through low orbit transmission and make up for the inability of communication network service due to the malfunction of GEO (Geostationary Earth Orbit) communication satellites. Through the analysis and scenario simulation of the regional communication rebuilding strategy, the validity and reliability of the regional rapid reconstruction of the LEO (Low Earth Orbit) micro-nano communications satellites are proved.

articleTitle: An Overview of Speech Synthesis Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Speech is the most natural and convenient approach of communication and speech synthesis technology is a kind of import application in Human-machine interaction system. This paper gives a comprehensive overview of Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis technology. The two basic parts of speech synthesis technology are natural language processing (NLP) and digital signal processing (DSP). To the part of NLP, some important steps are pre-processing, morphological analysis, contextual analysis, syntactic-prosodic analysis, phonetization and prosody generation. To the part of DSP, two types of synthesis methods are rule-driven methods and data-driven methods. Some important synthesis approaches of DSP such as articulatory synthesis, formant synthesis, concatenative synthesis, unit selection synthesis, HMM synthesis and DNN synthesis are introduced. Finally, these approaches of speech synthesis are compared briefly. The technical trends of TTS and some hot spots of its applications in the future are discussed.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Micromechanical Silicon Resonant Accelerometer with Low Temperature Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Because of the mismatch of material properties between silicon and glass, especially the mismatching thermal expansion coefficients, the Micromechanical Silicon Resonant Accelerometer based on the Deep Dry Silicon On Glass (DDSOG) technique is seriously affected by the temperature during the fabrication, packaging and use processes. Based on the working principle and temperature characteristics of Micromechanical Silicon Resonant Accelerometer, the effect of the mismatching thermal expansion coefficients of silicon and glass is analyzed, and a Single-Anchor-Supported accelerometer structure with low temperature sensitivity is designed. Simulation results show that the structure can effectively reduce the effect of mismatching thermal expansion coefficients of silicon and glass.

articleTitle: Indoor Positioning and Fingerprint Updating Based on Affinity Propagation Clustering
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In recent years, positioning in the indoor WiFi scene, the location of the fingerprint method is used in wireless indoor positioning, there are already through the smart phone automatically capture RSS fingerprints to build fingerprint library, reducing the workload of offline stage, but the automatic collection of RSS has a certain degree of unreliability and the updating of the fingerprint database is not timely and so on. In this paper, the automatic collection of fingerprints based on affinity propagation clustering, remove singular values, detect AP update method to ensure the reliability of fingerprint database. In the online phase WKNN and APC algorithms are combined. Experiments show that the improved fingerprint library can improve the positioning effect effectively by 20%, and make the automatic collection data based on the general package have good robustness.

articleTitle: Camera Calibration Based on Computer Vision and Measurement Adjustment Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Based on the pinhole model of considering the radial and tangential distortion in the computer vision, using Microsoft Visual Studio as the development platform, organized the camera calibration software Camera Calibration 1.0 with using the MFC which combined OpenCV. Through the calibration experiment of digital camera Canon 5D MarxII and the contrast experiment of close range photo grammetry commercial software Lens photo, the correctness of the camera calibration model and the reliability of camera calibration software Camera Calibration 1.0 are verified.Finally, the research results are applied to the investigation of the slope structural surface information of the quarry in Changchun, which provides detailed and basic data for slope stability evaluation based on stochastic dynamics.

articleTitle: Structure Analysis of Function Call Network Based on Percolation
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In software security analysis, selecting more important vertices can effectively improve the efficiency. Based on the theory of complex network, we form the complex function call network according to the call relation in binary software. The percolation of this network is carried out based on the index of vertex degree, betweenness centrality, the PageRank value and the number of neighbor connections. A comparison of vertex deletion was conducted to test the change of network structure by different strategies. The quantitative experiment shows that the two percolation processes of random deletions and preference deletions have great difference on the network structure, which indicates that the different index can be used to judge the importance of vertex.

articleTitle: A 10-GS/s Sample and Hold System for High-Speed Time-Interleaved ADC
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper presents a 10-GS/s sample and hold system, which is designed for a 16-way time-interleaved analog to digital converter (ADC). The sample and hold system is composed of three stage circuits. The multi-stage structure could make the sampling rate of 10GS/s down to the rate of sub-ADCs (625MS/s). To extend the bandwidth of the stage-1, a differential source-degenerated common-source amplifier with peaking inductance is adopted as an input buffer. A switched source follower samples the differential input signal at 10GHz. Moreover, the stage-2 is based on a wideband fully differential source-follower configuration. With the calibration technique, the source follower could eliminate the channel length modulation and the body effect. Therefore, the linearity of the proposed source follower is superior to the conventional ones.

articleTitle: Oil Pipeline Leak Detection Based on Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper studies the design of leak detection design for oil pipeline based on image recognition technology. The basic steps of the process are as follows: Firstly, by using the image processing function of MATLAB software, the oil pipeline images collected are processed, such as preprocessing, image recognition and segmentation, image morphological processing and so on. Finally, the leakage of oil pipeline is judged according to the test results. In the preprocessing part, gray processing is mainly performed, which can speed up the processing and improve the accuracy of recognition. The image segmentation section is selected using threshold segmentation. In the image morphology processing part, the edge contour obtained by the image segmentation part can be more clearly defined by the etching and expansion operation. The final output of the design is divided into three parts, one in which there is no leakage. In the other two cases, when a leak is detected, the degree of leakage is divided into a slight leak and a serious leak, which helps the tester to understand the leak more clearly and improve the practicability of the design.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis and Recovery Method for RAM of Spacecraft 1553B Bus Remote Terminal
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Unexpected failure could be caused by single event of RAM of the 1553B bus chip, which affects spacecraft's stability on orbit. In this paper, the 1553B RT (remote terminal) chip RAM is divided into several segments and each segment has different failure detect strategy. Based on this, the application software can detect the faults and locate where it is, then through isolation or replacement of fault, it can be recovered from the fault. Through simulation and verification on platform of OBC (On Board Computer), the failure detects and recovery strategy described in this paper is effective and has much more advantage in time and accuracy than the traditional method depended on the ground telecommand.

articleTitle: "Made in China 2025" Background of High-End Technical Skills Talents Training Innovation Model Research
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With reference to Germany's dual system applied talents training mode, combined with higher and secondary vocational and technical education at the present stage in China's reality, in the form of university-enterprise cooperation, combining the teaching process of CNC programming and processing technology, training can meet the demand of enterprise can quickly realize nc machine tool operation and programming technology, skilled talents, to achieve the skilled talents in vocational colleges and the seamless docking between unit of choose and employ persons. In teaching training equipment, teaching means and teaching method has carried on the new attempt, hierarchical teaching according to different students, theoretical study and practice the effective cohesion, greatly improving the teaching quality and teaching effect. This kind of study is a successful exploration to cultivate the model of high - end skill talents.

Author Keywords: The simulation of Numerical control lathe

articleTitle: Parameter Identification of Hydraulic Turbine Governing System Using White-Box Mapping Model and RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Considering a precise mathematic model is the foundation of unit status evaluation, fault diagnosis and power system analysis, it is necessary to identify the parameters of the hydraulic turbine governing system model which can describe its characteristic appropriately. According to the linear hydraulic turbine governing system model and model mapping theory, the white-box mapping model is established. However, the power generation units are all running under the regulation of power dispatch department strictly, which makes it is difficult to obtain enough operating data under various system inputs. To overcome the problem of data shortage, a RBF neural network parameter identification method depended on small-amount sample is presented in this paper. Simulation is conducted to verify the capacity of the proposed RBF neural network and white-box mapping model based parameter identification method for hydraulic turbine governing system in avoiding the dependence of large-amount test data and acquiring valid identification result.

Author Keywords: hydraulic turbine governing system, white-box mapping model

articleTitle: Low Carbon Constrained EPQ Model and Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Carbon constraints policies shall be prepared based on effects of carbon tax policies on different types of enterprises to achieve win-win results for the government and enterprises. A production-inventory model was established to the carbon tax constraints in this study to discuss the effects of carbon tax policies on inventory plans and carbon emissions of different types of enterprises and perform comparative analysis to the sensitivity of carbon tax rates for different types of enterprises. Numerical results demonstrate: enterprises may actively adjust their production-inventory arrangements under the current carbon tax policies so that carbon tax costs may fall; and as for any enterprise, the higher its production unit costs are, the weaker the sensitivity of its carbon taxes (namely its emission reduction may not be under good control by means of carbon tax policies). Suggestions were finally presented in accordance with our study conclusions to production enterprises and those who prepared carbon constraint policies.

articleTitle: Transition Performance Evaluation of a VTOL Tilt-Wing UAV
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A cost function to evaluate the transition performance of VTOL UAV is proposed. Based on transition performance analysis of different transition process, a cost function is constructed in consideration of the pitch angle tracking error, airspeed error and throttle command with different weight coefficient. The rationality of the cost function is validated by simulations with different influence factors. Both forward and backward transition simulation results show the cost function is reasonable. It is useful for transition performance evaluation, and it is helpful for transition strategy design to improve transition performance.

articleTitle: Design of PCM/FM Baseband Modulation Transmitter Based on Software Radio
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The PCM-FM system telemetry is the most widespread system in the field of aerospace telemetry in the day. However, the characteristics of traditional analog circuits make the system less flexible, the layout of the circuit is difficult, and the low-frequency response characteristics are not ideal. In response to the problems above, this paper uses a fully digital FPGA to implement the PCM-FM algorithm, with high accuracy, parameterized configuration and other features. Telemetry form is flexible and easy to debug. And it is easy to receive and send signals at both ends of the digital processing. The experimental results show that the use of FPGA chip to achieve digital signal processing algorithm for PCM-FM full digital baseband modulation can meet the requirements of a wide range of 1kbps~10Mbps baseband rate modulation.

articleTitle: A Model-Based Sliding-Mode Tracking Controller for Pneumatic Muscle Actuated Continuum Arms
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Pneumatic muscle actuator (PMA) multisection continuum arms are a class of continuum robotic manipulator which can bend and elongate with high flexibility. It presents challenges on kinematic modeling, dynamics modeling, and control. According to model shape functions, a modal kinematic model and a spatial dynamic model with numerical stability, we develop a model-based sliding mode controller used to demon-strate the effectiveness of these models and track desired trajec-tories precisely.

articleTitle: An Efficient Architecture for the Modified DLMS Algorithm Using CIC Filters
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Motivated by improvement of convergence properties, this work develops a new pipelined architecture for the modified delayed least mean square (DLMS) adaptive algorithm. The proposed architecture uses a correction term implemented by the first-order CIC filters to compensate for the degradation of convergence speed of the DLMS algorithm. Besides, the realization of CIC filter used for moving average arithmetic only needs one adder and a subtractor. The amount of calculation of the proposed adaptive filter is less than half of conventional architectures using look-ahead transformation. We use multiple-input addition algorithm to optimize the critical path and the hardware area for the proposed architecture. From some results of computer simulation we can find that the proposed design has roughly the same convergence as that of using LMS algorithm, which proves the proposed architecture is efficient.

articleTitle: Hardware Trojan Detection Technique Based on SOM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, we focus on hardware Trojans inserted into IC (Integrated Circuit) chips during IC design. We propose a hardware Trojan detection technique which is based on the chip temperature characterization by using SOM neural network. This method can achieve a high detection rate for Trojans without "gold chips". First, we use a tool called HotSpot to get the steady-state heatmap from running IC. Then, we make use of 2DPCA (Dimensional Principal Component Analysis) to extract the features of the heatmap profile and feed them into a SOM (Self Organizing Map) neural network. Finally, the SOM neural network automatically distinguishes Trojan-free chips from Trojaninfected chips. The experimental results show that our method can achieve high detection rate, with 20% chip PV (Process Variability), for all centralized Trojans which are located at different positions.

articleTitle: Image Edge Detection of Medical Cell Based on Morphology
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Doctors use electronic diagnostics to analyze cancer cells. However, The shape and size of cancer cells are small, and doctors can't accurately analyze cancer cells, leading to misdiagnosis of doctors. In order to solve this problem, we can use multi-scale morphological algorithm to extract tumor cells accurately. In this paper, Top-hat operator is used to enhance the image edge extraction. The edge image is obtained with high degree of closure, you can accurately calculate the cell parameters. This experiments show that the operator not only can filter out the noise, but also maintain the details of the image. This algorithm can highlight edge contours and extract image detail information, which is more effective than traditional morphology.

articleTitle: A Research on Virtual Training System Based on Force Feedback Data Glove
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: As the development of the Virtual Reality (VR) technology, the demands of the virtual training system has been extended from traditional visual requirements to tactile requirements. For this trend, this paper carried out a study on the virtual training system based on force feedback data glove. Firstly, an integrated data glove with functions of spatial positioning, action capture, and force feedback was designed to accomplish the tactile interaction between the user and the system. Then, a data interface adapter and a 3D virtual demonstration scene were developed to process and display the data information of the training operations. Applications of this system show that the system framework is reasonable and feasible, and the training effectiveness is remarkable.

articleTitle: Time-Series Analysis of Land Subsidence in Kunming
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Kunming is located in the northeastern margin of the Tibetan Plateau, covering the Quaternary sediments. With the development of the city, Kunming has had a large area of land subsidence in recent years. In this paper, time-series analysis of the land subsidence in Kunming was assessed by using permanent scatterers interferometric synthetic aperture radar (PS-InSAR) based on 28 single look complex Sentinel-1A images from 2014 to 2016. The result showed that the four subsidence areas were Xiaobanqiao-Guangwei village, Dongjuxin village -Yulong village, Dianchi Convention and Exhibition Center, and Palm Tree Camp. The most serious area of land subsidence was Xiaobanqiao-Guangwei Village, and its subsidence rate is 30mm/a. The largest settlement area is Dianchi Convention and Exhibition Center. Compared with other research results, the Xiaobaoqiao -Guangwei village and Dongju New Village-Yulong Village continue to subside and two new subsidence areas hve formed in Palm Tree Camp and Dianchi Convention and Exhibition Center. In Kunming, regional tectonic movement and its' special geological conditions, long-term groundwater exploitation, urban construction have led to land subsidence.

articleTitle: Study on Scrambling Algorithms of Error Reconciliation in QKD
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Quantum key distribution (referred to as QKD) is a technology that can produce and distribute secret keys unconditionally secure based on the principle of quantum mechanics. In a practical QKD system, the reconciliation efficiency is crucial to the final key rate of the system. A practical QKD system may produce the uneven error distribution of the sifted key due to the instabilities of optical and electronic devices and some other reasons, which will lead to the low reconciliation efficiency. Therefore, to scramble the sifted key is adopted in many QKD systems. In this paper, an Arnold-based Scrambling Algorithm and Fast Exchange Scrambling Algorithm are proposed mainly for the CASCADE class and WINNOW class error reconciliation algorithms. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithms provide the lower computational complexity and higher scrambling efficiency than the representative scrambling algorithm in QKD.

articleTitle: Density-Based Fuzzy C-Means Multi-Center Re-Clustering Radar Signal Sorting Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The strategic position of electronic warfare in modern warfare is constantly improving, and radar detection is the eye of modern information warfare and plays an important role in electronic warfare. This paper designs a new pulse radar sorting algorithm: a Density-Based Fuzzy C-Means Multi-Center Re-Clustering (DFCMRC) radar signal sorting algorithm. This algorithm combines the advantages of the DBSCAN density clustering algorithm and the fuzzy C-means (FCM) clustering algorithm. This paper also optimizes the structure of the DFCMRC algorithm? which changes the algorithm that randomly generated the initial center point to the CFSFDP algorithm. After comparison tests, the DFCMRC algorithm sorting result is better than the k-means algorithm, the DBSCAN algorithm and the FCM algorithm. Also, the membership degree description of DFCMRC is more reasonable than the FCM's. Accelerated optimized DFCMRC algorithm can reduce more than half iterations, which greatly shortens the algorithm calculation time.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of High Frequency Signal Generator Based on DDS
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: DDS direct digital frequency synthesis, is a key digital technology. The system to DDS technology as the core, consists of AD9910, STM32 module, TFTLCD display module, filter circuit, automatic level control module. Compared with the traditional frequency synthesizer with a low cost, low power consumption, high resolution, fast switching time, good Spurious suppression, etc. The system is to develop a high-frequency sinusoidal signal generator, which is based on the integrated DDS chip-AD9910 and used the STM32 MCU as control unit. The signal generator can adjust frequency, phase and amplitude of the signal by touching the keyboard on the TFTLCD screen and the value will be displayed on the screen. In addition it has AM,FM,PM modulation and sweep function. The function of the signal generator to achieve the following innovations: (1) High frequency, full functioning; (2) Cancel the button, with the touch screen of the virtual button instead, Combine the keys with the display; (3) Using Chebyshev filter to achieve multi-level filtering, the output bandwidth of 400MHz; (4) back-end high-frequency amplifier circuit using OPA695 design, the amplifier 2 times the output bandwidth of 800MHz bandwidth, input 400MHz signal output amplitude up to 1Vpp; (5) Compared to other solutions, it greatly shortening the development cycle.

articleTitle: A Novel Absolute Angle-Measuring Method with Rotary Inductosyn
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel absolute angle-measuring method with rotary inductosyn to meet the requirements of high-precision and absolute angle measurement. Besides, a feasible system based on the method is presented and the simulation verification is also provided. This method takes advantage of a 720-poles' rotary inductosyn and a 718-poles' rotary inductosyn to obtain a high precise absolute angle firstly and then utilizes a higher precise relative angle value of 720- poles' inductosyn to achieve angle coupling. This method has many appealing characteristics, such as absolute angle measuring, high-precision, small size, high reliability and anti-seismic, etc. The principle equations and coupling algorithm of this method are deduced and the results of simulation are given in this paper as well.

articleTitle: Fake Examinees Preventing Admission Ticket Based on Quick Response Code and Biometrics
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In recent years, the phenomenon of fake examinees taking the test is becoming more and more common. The traditional method of examination authentication is to examine the identity card and the admission ticket of the examinee. Now, more and more researchers applied biometrics to identity authentication. In this paper, we propose a scheme to generate a fake examinees preventing admission ticket based on Quick Response Code (QR) and iris biometrics. We give the process of identity authentication when examinees use the admission ticket designed by our scheme. Our scheme improves the accuracy of authentication. Besides, we embed examinee's photo into the QR code, which improves the usage of the admission ticket page. Moreover, the examinees themselves hold their own iris information, thus there is no database to store examinees' iris information in the examinee authentication system which effectively prevents internal personnel from leaking and external personnel from attacking the database for the threat of iris biological information leakage.

articleTitle: Rapid Precision Evaluation of Roundness Error in Polar Coordinates
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A new method for evaluating roundness error in polar coordinates is proposed. The principle and procedure of solving roundness error are described in detail. A certain number of uniformly distributed position points are preset as the initial evaluation center. The maximum value, minimum value and extreme value difference between each position point and measurement point are calculated by using the two-point distance formula. To reduce the search area, the smaller center area and its position point are created with the extreme point as the center. The comparison and measurement results of the actual roundness error show that the method proposed is accurate and fast, and has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: A Weibo APP Design Based on Eclipse and Android Platforms
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Two platforms, namely Eclipse and Android sdk, are adopted in this design for the development of the Android version of Weibo. To ensure a successful run of the APP in the Android system, a framework of image and windows programming designs is introduced into the programming procedure. A brief introduction to Android and Weibo is made in this paper before an analysis concerning the architecture of Android system, its kernel, and different parts of the Android applications being presented. In this connection, software development kits like Eclipse, JDK, Android SDK, and ADT are employed to establish a platform for the development of apps with a concise illustration of Weibo's different modules. Following this exists an introduction to the architecture of Android system and its kernel. Finally, technologies adopted in the design are examined in this paper, with a focus on image programming design, windows interface programming design, and windows function design with detailed design scheme and programming procedure being presented as well. This study is of practical value considering that a facilitated development platform for Android apps is offered.

articleTitle: An Improved 2-Opt and ACO Hybrid Algorithm for TSP
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, an improved 2-optimization(2-opt) and Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) Hybrid Algorithm is proposed to solve the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). The improved scheme of ACO is to define the indirect expectation heuristic and introduce it into the calculation method of transition probability, which will reduce the effect of pheromone on ant selecting path and increase the path's diversity of ACO. In this way, the deficiency of ACO in convergence to local optimal solution will be made up. Considering of the stronger local search ability, 2-opt algorithm is used to optimize existing solutions, and the better solution is obtained. Finally, the performance of the proposed algorithm is evaluated by the classical TSP problem.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of Undulate Terrain on the Geometric Accuracy of Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In recent years, with the improvement of the stability and mobility of optical remote sensing satellite platforms, the field of view and the width of remote sensing satellites have also increased dramatically. The wide-range and large-field-of-view remote sensing make the effect of topography fluctuations on the geometric positioning accuracy of remote sensing satellites from linear to nonlinear. It is of great significance to analyze the effect of topographic relief on the geometric accuracy of push-scan optical remote sensing satellites for improving the geometric positioning accuracy of optical remote sensing satellites. Firstly, this paper analyzes how the topographic relief affects the geometric positioning accuracy in optical remote sensing satellite geometry imaging links, through the analysis it is concluded that the image shift of satellite remote sensing image caused by topographic relief is related to the ground elevation, focal length and side-swing angle; Secondly, Using the parameters of the Worldview-2 and ZY-3 satellites to simulate and verify the image shifts of remote sensing images under different satellite focal lengths, side-swing angles and ground elevation conditions; Finally, Gaussian synthesis surface model is used to simulate different terrains (plains, hills, mountains, high mountains) to obtain satellite remote sensing simulation images, and the direct positioning method is used to get the geometric positioning deviation of remote sensing satellites caused by different terrain relief conditions.

articleTitle: Influence Factor Analysis of the Recoverable Rocket Trajectory Planning Based on Multi-Pulse Path Planning Model
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Based on the robotic path planning method, this paper conducted a research on the multi-pulse trajectory planning model of the recoverable rocket, and verified whether the model has enough feasibility and recovery precision to satisfy the engineering requirements. Firstly, by comparing the instantaneous pulse model and finite pulse width overload model, this paper analyzed the effectiveness, feasibility and precision of the model. Then this paper verified the validity of the multi-pulse trajectory planning model and analyzed the influences of dynamic constraints on the rocket trajectory quantitatively. Lastly, this paper analyzed the limit of the pulse number and the influence factors of the pulse number. The analysis results show the multi-pulse trajectory planning model of the recoverable rocket is correct, and the trajectory generated by this model is feasible in engineering practice.

articleTitle: Secure Multiparty Computation via Fully Homomorphic Encryption Scheme
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With the rapid development and popularization of cloud computing, the security multiparty computation becomes a hot issue for the current research. This paper combs and analyzes the research of general security multiparty computation in cloud computing environment, and introduces the solution encryption schemes, including multi-key fully homomorphic encryption scheme based on Learning with errors and multi-key fully homomorphic attribute-based encryption scheme. This paper discusses the directions for future works in the end.

articleTitle: Design of Combinatorial Test Algorithm for Memory Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The memory device used in high reliability field of aerospace needs fast fault diagnosis and location when function failure occurs, but simple function verification test can not even detect failure due to low fault coverage. The combination test algorithm designed by using different memory test algorithms for the coverage difference of fault mode is analyzed by the results of multiple iterations, sometimes the fault points can be accurately positioned and the failure analysis is completed. Based on an example of SRAM failure analysis, a design method of combined test algorithm for fault diagnosis is presented.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control on Dual-Channel Closed-Loop Supply Chain Model and Its Bullwhip Effect
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, a model predictive control algorithm to restrain bullwhip effect of Dual-channel closed-loop supply chain networks dynamic system under E-commerce environment is studied. First, the state space dynamic model of Dual-channel closed-loop supply chain model under E-commerce environment is established; A l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> norm measure method of bullwhip effect is presented; Based on the established system prediction model, the calculation formula of state estimation and prediction are given; the multi-stage optimal prediction model expressions are deduced; the objective function and the feedback correction method are given; the constrained optimization algorithm based on quadratic optimization is derived; and the general steps of this algorithm is given; Finally, by an example, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified. The essence of this algorithm is that with applying the rolling optimization and continuous implementations, adjusting the control variables such as the order quantity and production, the system has good dynamic performances in the premise of stability, the bullwhip effects are restrained.

Author Keywords: dual- channel closed-loop supply chain networks

articleTitle: Sensorless Temperature Estimator of the Rotor for Submersible Motor Based on Input Voltages and Currents
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In the later stage of oil field exploitation, the submersible motor will lead to overheating and excessive energy consumption because of underrunning. Monitoring of the rotor temperature is very important for both control and protection of induction machines. Temperature sensors are usually avoided due to additional wiring. In this paper, a novel temperature identification method based on rotor slot harmonics is proposed. The mathematical model of submersible motor under high temperature and high pressure is established by analyzing the laws between the motor parameters and load, voltage and current. And the parameters and temperature identification of submersible motor can be carried out according to calculating the proposed model with the sampling voltage and current, so as to realize accurate system monitoring and reliable fault diagnosis. Opposed to temperature sensors and previous solutions where temperature is calculated based on the real part of the impedance, the presented method is calculated from the change of the rotor resistance.

articleTitle: A Magnetic Beacon Navigation and Positioning Technology Not Relying on GPS
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A magnetic beacon navigation and positioning technology which can work without GPS is investigated in this paper. We use the magnetic coil as a beacon in the low frequency magnetic field and the navigation. In addition, positioning methods based on extended Kalman filter (EKF) and data fusion algorithm are applied to improve the accuracy of the system. The method of navigation and positioning of this magnetic beacon is explained by simulation, indicating that the proposed magnetic beacon navigation and positioning algorithm is attractive for many environments where GPS signals are restricted, such as indoor robot navigation, underground physical exploration and so on.

articleTitle: Design of Output Capability Test System for High Power Servo Driver
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With the development of electromechanical servo technology, the electromechanical servo mechanism, with its small size, simple reliability, easy maintenance, good process and easy control, has attracted extensive attention and in-depth research, and has been widely used in the field of aerospace. With the complication of application environment and situation of electromechanical servo system, It is necessary for the servo driver to carry out its own characteristic test before the whole assembly test. The performance test of Servo drive is an important process before the factory. Its performance also directly affects the subsequent system debugging, which makes the development of testing system and method of current output capability of high voltage and large current high-power driver appear very important. At present, for the performance test of Servo drive, it is realized by using v/f mode output fixed amplitude and frequency current, this method can only test the performance of servo drive under specific operating conditions, but not the performance curve of the whole flight process, and it is difficult to judge whether the drive meets the flight requirements. If the actual condition is completely simulated, a large number of test equipment is needed, which can only be targeted at a specific project, and will cause waste of resources. Therefore, it is very important to study the optimal matching of the control parameters of the electromechanical servo system in low voltage system and the test and debugging methods in the process of mastering the design technology of the electromechanical servo system of the Low-voltage high current energy system, the low voltage large current servo-control driving technology and the low voltage dynamic servo motor design Technology Keywords: Aerospace servo-driven flight curve simulation output capability test cost control.

articleTitle: An Algorithm of Optimization for Linear Nearest Neighbor Quantum Circuits by Parallel Processing
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to realize the linear nearest neighbor(LNN) of quantum circuits and reduce the quantum cost of the linear reversible quantum circuits, a method of synthesizing and optimizing linear reversible quantum circuits based on matrix multiplication is proposed. This method shows the matrix representation of linear quantum circuits by proposing the matrix representation of the CNOT gate and the SWAP gate. The rule of judging whether a two-qubit quantum circuit is in LNN state is proposed. The LNN realization by adding SWAP gates is proposed and the equivalence of two ways of adding SWAP gates is proved. The elimination rules of SWAP gates between two overlapped adjacent quantum gates in different cases are proposed, which reduce the quantum cost of quantum circuits after realizing the LNN architecture. We propose a particular algorithm to realize the LNN, which can effectively reduce the quantum cost and improve calculation efficiency by inserting the SWAP gates on parallel computing devices. Experiments show that the quantum cost can be improved by 34.31% on average and the speed-up ratio of the GPU-based algorithm can reach 4 times compared with the CPU-based algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of Control System of Full-Automatic Detection Line for Inner and Outer Rings of Bearings
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, I introduces a control system of automatic detection line for bearing parts. The detection line is mainly used to detect the parameters of the inner ring and outer ring of y bearings before assembly. The detection line control system is mainly composed of ABB robot automatic feeding system, truss manipulator handling system, detection platform system and SPC software system, which realizes the functions of automatic feeding, transporting, detecting and offline products. This detection line is successfully applied to the pre-installation inspection of bearings in a large bearing factory, which improved the assembly quality of products, ensured the qualified rate of products and improved the core competitiveness of products.

articleTitle: Research on the Quadrotor of AHRS Based on Gradient Descent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: It is the focus of research on the navigation algorithm with high-accurated and easy-achieved for UAV. In this paper a gradient descent algorithm for AHRS of Quadrotor by using MEMS gyro, accelerometer, and magnetometer is presented. The algorithm uses a quaternion represent rotation, allowing accelerometer and magnetometer data to be used in an analytically derived and optimised gradient descent algorithm to compute the direction of the gyroscope measurement error as a quaternion derivative. Through the simulation based on Matlab software, the algorithm can significantly reduces the requirement for the processor of speed and precision, effectively fusing the data of the MEMS sensor, and achieves the high-accurated attitude calculation of Quadrotor.

articleTitle: Detecting Masqueraders by Profiling User Behaviors
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Insider attack is a serious threat to enterprises, organizations and countries. It has become a widely studied topic in the field of information security. This paper mainly aims to effectively detect masqueraders by profiling user behaviors with keystroke and network traffic. The fly-time of digraph is employed to build users' keystroke behavior. User network behavior is modeled with statistic and text features that are extracted from network traffic. The K-Means classifier is used to classify network traffic, and different classification results are mapped to different user operations accordingly. Extensive experimental result shows that, in the case of users' keystroke models, the detection rate is achieved from 77% to 87.5% and the false alarm rate is 0.44 %. When we use network models, the detection rate is 100% with the false alarm rate as 0.05%. In conclusion, network traffic can describe user network behaviors precisely, while the detection rate of user keystroke behaviors suffers from the insufficient user input from keyboard. It is obvious that a certain masquerader detection mechanism which is based on specific user behaviors, cannot reach satisfied results since the corresponding data is insufficient in different scenarios. It is necessary to use both two type of behaviors for different scenarios to achieve a better detection result.

articleTitle: An Improved Method Based on Joint Feature Vector for Audio Broadcasting Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper presents an improved method applied to audio broadcasting surveillance. The method is designed for interference detection and noise classification. Based on Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) and time domain parameters forming joint feature vector of audio, the method realizes the discrimination of propagation time delay, content faults, weak signal and inter-channel white noise.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Communication and Processing System for Radar Testing Based on ZYNQ
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: To improve the performance of data processing in radar testing, a new design is proposed to realize the serial real-time communication. This design is based on ZYNQ, a kind of all programmable SoC produced by Xilinx. The ZYNQ SoC resource is composed of two parts: the processing system (PS) and the programmable logic (PL). Compared with the conventional communication and processing systems based on FPGA and PXI bus, this new design has several advantages and compatibility. The hardware of this design consist of core board with ZYNQ, PXI-bus interface, serial communication ports such as RS-485, RS-422, and RS-232, configuration ports such as USB, Ethernet, and UART. Meanwhile, the software of this design is divided into two parts: upper visual software and embedded software in the PS. To realize the key 10ms real-time communication demand, an accurate timing module is designed in the PL. The experimental results show that the new design only cost about 4 ms to operate the whole communication and data calculation. In addition, the complex serial communication protocols and the control commands are configurable with UI.

articleTitle: Distributed Continuous Finite-Time Containment Control for Euler-Lagrange Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this research, we mainly proposed a distributed containment control algorithm for Euler-Lagrange system, where general disturbances are considered. Also directed topologies are used to describe the leader-following case. First, we introduced the error variables, linear sliding variable, and terminal sliding variable. Then the control algorithm was proposed for the EL system expressed by EL equations. By using the Lyapunov theory and some lemmas, we proved the control errors of the system converge to the original point along the sliding mode. The followers can converge to the convex hull formed by the leaders in finite time.

articleTitle: Research on Life Detection of Search Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: When the coal mine accident happened, the gas and carbon monoxide concentration in the mine is higher, the environment is bad and the smoke is heavy, which brings great inconvenience to the rescue work after the disaster. In order to search for the surviving miners in time after the mine disaster, the life detection system of the search and rescue robot is studied in this paper. This paper first introduces the life detection techniques in the use of the tunnel after the disaster, the echo signal of through wall radar is theoretically deduced, and the Bessel function is used to process the echo signal. The basic frequency of breathing and heartbeat and the harmonic combination of the two are simulated.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Spacecraft Onboard Network Based on LWIP
