publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A spacecraft onboard network connects all devices on a spacecraft together. State-of-the-art spacecraft onboard networks have several problems to support modern spacecraft applications. In this paper, we design and implement a spacecraft onboard network based on the LWIP protocol stack to solve these problems. We introduce the design of the protocol stack and the network system, and introduce the detail of integrating LWIP protocols with existing spacecraft software such as VxWorks and using LWIP protocols in spacecraft applications.

articleTitle: An Acquisition Research into Radial Artery Tremor Signal Based on PVDF
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: as a dynamic strain piezoelectric sensor, Piezoelectric polyvinylidene fluoride polymer film (PVDF) is ideal for physiological signal monitoring of human skin surface or implanted within the body. In this study, PVDF is used as a sensor and the design of signal acquisition and conditioning circuit is carried out according to the following ideas. Firstly, the circuit model of piezoelectric film is established on the basis of PVDF piezoelectric principle and piezoelectric characteristics. Secondly, according to the piezoelectric characteristics of PVDF, an automatic gain signal conditioning circuit is designed based on charge amplifier. Of which the passband range is less than 40Hz. Finally, a more convenient PVDF sensor structure will be proposed to achieve dynamic monitoring of radial artery tremor. The experimental results show that the piezoelectric signal conditioning circuit can filter out the signal clutter and power frequency noise well and maintain a stable high gain for a given frequency range.

articleTitle: Study on Influence of Non-Contact Measuring Circuit on Micro EDM Using Non-Contact Electric Feeding Method
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In micro electrical discharge machining (EDM) using non-contact electric feeding method, a measuring electrode is coupled to the tool electrode by capacity coupling to measure the gap voltage indirectly. Especially in micro discharge energy, the influence of the parameters of the non-contact measuring circuit on the working gap voltage and the measuring voltage has not been studied yet, meanwhile, the working gap voltage and the measuring voltage affect the discharge energy and the servo control of the discharge gap. Therefore, in order to clarify the influence of the parameters in the non-contact measuring circuit on the micro EDM using non-contact electric feeding method, the relationship between the parameters of the non-contact measuring circuit and the working gap voltage or the measuring voltage was analyzed by MULTISIM(circuit simulation software) in this paper. Finally, the influence of the working gap voltage is minimized and the servo control of the gap width in Micro EDM is realized by selecting reasonable parameters of the non-contact measuring circuit.

articleTitle: Prediction Model of MBR Membrane Flux for Elman Neural Network Based on PSO-GA Hybrid Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Membrane fouling reduces wastewater treatment efficiency and cause financial and energy costs to some extent. The size of membrane flux reflects the degree of membrane pollution. Make timely cleaning membrane or replacement membrane decision to maintain considerable treatment effect on the basis of the membrane flux. Particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm can quickly find the global optimum. Genetic algorithm (GA) has the property of global convergence. The prediction model used in this paper is based on the PSO-GA hybrid algorithm. The combination of these not only improves the convergence speed of genetic algorithm but also reduces the probability of particle swarm optimization algorithm falling into local optimum. Elman neural network acts as the basic network. Compared with Elman neural network and BP neural network, the prediction accuracy of PSO-GA-Elman is improved.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Workpiece Deformation in Thin-Wall Milling under Coupled Thermal-Mechanical Conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The key component of an aero engine consists of many thin-walled structural parts. Machining accuracy of these thin-walled parts which have low-rigidity is greatly influenced by cutting deformation in milling process. Prediction of cutting deformation could effectively decrease surface errors of the part through optimizing tool path or cutting parameters. In this paper, deformation mechanism of the workpiece during thin-wall milling is studied by simulation method and cutting tests. The analytical model of cutting force which is suitable for thin-wall milling is established, and the model of temperature field during milling process is built to predict cutting heat of the workpiece. Model parameters of cutting force and temperature are determined to satisfy the current cutting conditions based on several orthogonal experiments. Cutting deformation of the workpiece at different time could be calculated by finite element method under coupled thermal-mechanical conditions. According to the experimental results, the proposed simulation method could minimize the error between the calculation value and detection value in terms of workpiece deformation.

articleTitle: An Improved Quartile Fault Tolerant Filter Algorithm for Intelligent Ship
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of intermittent failure of the sensor equipped in intelligent ship due to the change of working environment and the interference between the equipment and other factors in the autonomous navigation, a fault tolerant filter algorithm was designed. Combining with the sliding quartile filter, the residual compensation and the linear estimation, the sensor data with noise interference and intermittent packet loss was filtered to obtain more real data, which is conducive to improving the control accuracy of the intelligent vessel. At the same time, fading memory factor was introduced to reduce the weight of historical measurement data in linear estimation. It is proved that the algorithm has a high fault tolerance for sensor intermittent fault by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: A Smart Design of Hardware Trojan and Differential Fault Analysis in AES
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Hardware Trojan is an additional circuit with malicious functions in integrated circuit (IC), which can leak the secret information of integrated circuit under rare conditions. In this paper, we propose a hardware Trojan of small scale and low trigger probability in AES encryption circuit, which can inject fault in AES circuit. And we can get the key information in AES circuit by differential fault analysis. The result of attack experiment on the FPGA chip shows that two groups of correct ciphertext and wrong ciphertext can be used to restore the whole key in AES, and it only takes 5s.

articleTitle: Automatic Detection of Stack Overflow Attack in Canary
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The existing buffer overflow vulnerability detection technology checks the control flow state of the program to determine the trigger point of the program and generate test cases. However, due to the limitation of the canary protection mechanism, it is difficult for the existing detection technology to determine whether the program satisfies the stack overflow attack condition in canary. In order to improve the security of the program and realize the detection of stack overflow attacks, this paper analyzes the existing stack overflow attack instances, summarizes the features of stack overflow attack, and builds an automatic stack overflow detection method in canary. The method uses taint analysis to monitor the input data of the program and the sensitive operation; uses the selective symbol execution technology to construct the path constraint and the data constraint of the stack overflow attack; generates a test case by solving the above constraints. Experiments show that this method can effectively achieve the detection of stack overflow attacks.

articleTitle: The Simulation and Verification Platform for Micro-Satellite Integrated Electronic Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to meet the requirement of modeling, simulation and verification for micro-satellite avionics, the on-board communication bus for micro-satellite avionics was modeled and simulated. The character of real-time, network delay and throughput was simulated to support the development of the avionics. The simulation and verification platform was developed to support the network framework, communication protocol, system control and data flow design and components' test.

articleTitle: Magnetic Coupled Resonant Wireless Power Transfer System Characteristics with Orientation
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Based on the principle of magnetic coupled resonance theory, the problem of offset, which influences wireless power transfer system transfer characteristic is analyzed. With equivalent circuit theory, the relationship between transfer power, transfer efficiency and charge current with primary and secondary coils' mutual inductance is obtained, and then give the mathematical expression of the offset direction and the mutual inductance. Through Ansoft simulation, analyze the relationship between circular and rectangular coils' X or Y axis and diagonal offset with mutual inductance. Then use Pspice simulation analyze mutual inductance's influence on the system's transfer characteristics. Finally, based on theoretical analysis and software simulation, propose the secondary Buck converter impedance adjustment method, with PI algorithm control Buck converter's duty ratio, when the system offset occurs, the stability of wireless power transfer characteristic can be ensured.

articleTitle: Tactile P300 Brian-Computer Interface Paradigm for Robot Arm Control
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper presents a tactile BCI for movement control of a three degree-of-freedom(DOF) robot arm. Six physical stimulus modules were placed on the left arm of the participant to stimulate event-related potentials with time-domain characteristics. Six different commands could be exported by classifying the Electroencephalogram(EEG) signal, which could control the robot arm movement in the corresponding position. To test the practicality of our BCI system, 5 subjects took part in the experiment with their appropriate stimulation time, electrode channel and corresponding classifier parameters. In the online experiment, the average of classification accuracy was 84.7%, with an average information transfer rate at 12.2 bits/min. In the robot arm control experiment, all subjects could complete a reach-to-grasp task. The results show that the tactile BCI paradigm is feasible and practical for some multi-DOF control applications.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control of UAVs for Mine Searching
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Mine search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can replace rescue personnel to quickly enter complex and dangerous post disaster sites, complete environmental detection and personnel search tasks. Cooperative control of UAVs is the key technology of underground search and rescue mobile communication network and blind area search. Starting from the special environment characteristics of the mine and the requirement of multiple UAVs cooperative control, this article studies the cooperative control method of multiple UAVs based on improved particle swarm optimization algorithm. Using improved A* algorithm, the shortest path of obstacle between two track points is planned. The shortest path is used as the input of the global objective function in the task allocation process, and the particle swarm structure corresponding to the coordination system is used to improve the particle swarm optimization task allocation and iterative optimization. The simulation results show that the algorithm can produce reasonable task assignment results and automatic obstacle avoidance route planning control for UAV while guaranteeing the computation speed and convergence performance.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Energy-Efficient Epidemic Routing for Delay Tolerant Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Delay tolerant networks (DTNs) are network environments with high latency, low data rate, intermittent connection, and limited resources. The communication between the nodes is conducted through the store-carry-forward mechanism, and multi-copy routing strategy is often used to improve the reliability of communication. In order to improve the message delivery probability, reduce network overhead and manage the node buffer more effectively in DTNs, this paper proposed a dynamic energy-efficient Epidemic routing algorithm for DTNs (DERD). The algorithm utilizes the dynamic energy threshold strategy to determine whether to transmit the message from the sending node to the receiving node, the ACK acknowledgment information is incorporated in the algorithm to delete the outdated message. The simulation results show that the algorithm is superior to the contrast routing algorithm in terms of the number of survived nodes, message delivery probability and network overhead ratio.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Infrared Image Preprocessing Method Based on Background Complexity Descriptors
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Infrared image complexity is applied widely in target recognition of complex scenario, infrared imaging system performance prediction and evaluation, performance comparison of target recognition algorithms, and other fields. This paper presents an adaptive infrared image preprocessing method. First, the variance weighted information entropy for quantitative description of Infrared background complexity is proposed. Second, the optimal cut-off frequency of the filter is designed by the background complexity of the real-time image. Finally, an improved high-pass Butterworth filter is used for adaptive preprocessing for complex infrared images.

articleTitle: A Method of Real Time and Fast Lane Line Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to effectively realize the feature extraction of road image, reduce the complexity of calculation and the complexity of algorithm and improve the detection accuracy of lane mark, combined with the characteristics of lane line, in this paper, an effective image preprocessing scheme was selected and designed, and a detection method based on segmented ROI model which included close region, sub-close region and respective region was proposed. In the different segmentation region, the SHT method was used to detect and carry out the segmentation method to detect the lane line. The experiment results showed that the method could improve the detection accuracy of the lane line, greatly reduce the amount of data processed and improve the efficiency of the detection time. The real-time performance for the lane line detection could be improved obviously by segmented ROI model.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Dynamic Inversion Control of VTOL Tilt-Wing UAV
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Tilt-wing vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) UAV is a combination of long endurance and VTOL capability. The highly nonlinear dynamics and multi-actuator control during mode transition are the two key problems. The coupling between pitch angle and airspeed during transition is critical for the VTOL tilt-wing UAV. Firstly, the transition must ensure the control of the pitch angle. A nonlinear dynamic inversion (NDI) controller is designed to track pitch angle command. The controller is divided into fast and slow subsystems based on the principle of time-scale separation. Control allocation is used to deal with multi-actuators during mode transition. Simulation results show that, compared with the PID controller, the NDI controller can achieve better tracking performance, and it is robust to aerodynamic parameter perturbation.

articleTitle: Research of a Fault Prediction Method of the Electronic Equipment Based on ARMA - Elman Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of the fault prediction of the electronic equipment, a novel fault prediction method based on ARMA-Elman neural network model is presented. The ARMA- Elman neural network model combines the fitting ability of ARMA model to linear time series with the mapping ability of Elman neural network to nonlinear time series. The forecasting model is tested by the actual data from high-voltage power supply of radar transmitter. Simulation result shows that the prediction accuracy of ARMA-Elman neural network model has better prediction accuracy than the single ARMA model and Elman neural network model. So this method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Research of LDPC Coding and Encoding for Satellite Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: As the increasing demands of spatial frequency resources, more and more geostationary satellites use Ka-band to realize high-speed data transmission. The data transmission link has characteristics of long distance and high rain attenuation. For the convenience of data processing and improving the performance of codecs, quasi - cyclic LDPC (QC-LDPC) and log - likelihood ratio decoding (LLR-BP) algorithms are designed. This paper mainly studies the coding and decoding algorithm of LDPC, proposes the overall optimized design method of the satellite communication system, finally gives the verification results of a nearly launched geostationary orbit satellite.

articleTitle: The Research on Navigation Technology of Dead Reckoning Based on UWB Localization
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the accuracy and stability of indoor positioning navigation can not meet the requirements of engineering, a navigation method based on UWB positioning is designed. First of all, in view of the positioning error of UWB, the TOF algorithm is applied to measure distance, and an algorithm of inner quadrilateral positioning is proposed to improve the positioning accuracy. Secondly, In the aspect of the large deviation of navigation direction, the dead reckoning algorithm based on nine-axis module surveying angle and encoder range are designed, which effectively settle the problem of zero drift and improve the navigation precision. Finally, an integrated navigation algorithm is proposed, it combines the advantages of UWB positioning technology and dead reckoning. This method can improve the performance of positioning navigation effectively. The system can carry out indoor positioning navigation stably, rapidly and accurately through practice.

articleTitle: The Finite-Time Stability of a Class of Fractional Order Nonlinear Systems via Dynamic Sliding Mode
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, the finite-time stability of a class of fractional order nonlinear systems is studied. By using the finite-time stability and the sliding mode control theory, a new dynamic sliding-mode controller is proposed, which will restrain the chattering and accelerated arrival at the sliding surface. The finite-time stability of the fractional-order nonlinear systems with external disturbances and uncertainties is achieved under the designed controller. Finally, one typical examples of three-dimensional fractional order Lorenz system are used to demonstrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the designed controller.

articleTitle: Improved Initial Clustering Center Selection Method for k-Means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Aiming at the Randomness about selecting the initial center point.This paper presents improvement scheme, in which one can select initial center point based on the Pearson correlation to avoid the randomness. After the experiment, the initial center point selected can effectively reduce the number of iterations of the clustering algorithm, and improve the efficiency of clustering algorithm. In the mean time, clustering results and the number of iterations has good stability.

articleTitle: Design of Bluetooth Mesh Network Switch Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Bluetooth technology is traditionally based on the point-to-point transmission protocol. It has limited transmission distance and poor networking capabilities, making it is very rare in the field of Internet of things. Traditional switches are mechanical switches, which are not safe or convenient. The traditional way to achieve this is to use Bluetooth devices and microcontrollers implement one-on-one control. Based on these issues, we will propose the concept of Bluetooth Mesh. It is a multi-hop technology that extends the transmission distance between Bluetooth nodes in a wide range and solves the limitations of traditional Bluetooth. By embedding Bluetooth Mesh technology into each switch, a Bluetooth Mesh network system is formed, and the system can be controlled by the mobile phone. The Bluetooth Mesh network switch control system can integrate technology into life and make people's life more secure and convenient.

articleTitle: Design of Ground Dynamics Simulation Platform for Satellite Control Test
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, the design of the test case, the demand for the traction, the existing ground dynamics in the star dynamics, astronomical kinematics, gyro sensors, solar sensors, infrared globe sensors and star sensors to simplify the model, developed based on VxWorks satellite ground dynamics simulation software, the application of the simulation software and the AOCC simulator on the formation of closed-loop simulation system, and gives the ground dynamic model simulation results, the results show that the software design is reasonable, real-time, the results are correct, And the model can be configured, easy to expand, and the development of test technology play a positive role in promoting.

articleTitle: An Improved Method of Wavelet Threshold Denoising for Satellite Signal
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: As an important tool, wavelet analysis has been widely used in modern signal processing. In order to reduce the noise of satellite signal, wavelet transform is a very good method. Threshold function is an important component of wavelet threshold denoising. Traditional threshold functions include hard and soft threshold functions, but each has its own disadvantages. The hard threshold function is not continuous, which will lead to greater variance. The soft threshold approach often results in partial loss of high frequency information. In order to overcome these disadvantages, an improved threshold function is proposed in this article. The simulation shows that the proposed approach has better denoising performance than other threshold functions when it is used for denoising. In the process of signal processing, this method is very suitable for these cases where accuracy is high but computational requirements are not high.

articleTitle: Moving Target Location Method Based on Euclidean Distance and Camshift Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Moving target location and tracking is a very complicated problem, especially, the occlusion problem gradually becomes the limitation of the practical tracking algorithm. Because of the moving targets in video monitoring can be occluded by the obstacles in the moving process, it can reduce target positioning accuracy, and even lead to the target track losing. To resolve the problems, a new location algorithm has been proposed in this paper. The preprocessing of video image is realized through the basic process of Gauss foreground detection, Kalman filter, expansion and occlusion judgment. And then, the method based on the Kalman prediction and the adaptive threshold value which determined by the Euclidean distance of the target motion trajectory, and the target centroids have been searched by Camshift algorithm. The test results show that the method of using the Euclidean distance of the target trajectory as the prediction threshold can not only effectively locate the moving target, but also resist to the adverse effects of the occlusion object, and reduce the loss rate of tracking.

articleTitle: Temperature Control Optimization for Heat Pipe Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to optimize the parameters of heat pipe temperature control during the thermal vacuum test, the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to tune the PID control parameters. According to the heat response data of heat pipe, the temperature control system model of heat pipe is established. The time integral of the absolute value of the control error is selected as the objective function. The parameters of the particle swarm optimization algorithm are compared with those of the attenuation curve method, and compares the control result based on parameter from PSO and the attenuation curve method. The simulation result shows that the optimization algorithm can accelerate the convergence rate. The setting time of system is cut down from 10h to 3.7h, and the maximum overshoot decreases from 16.7% to 1.4%. The dynamic performance of system is effectively improved.

articleTitle: Design of an Automatic Mode-Matching System for MEMS Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper reports an automatic mode-matching system for MEMS gyroscope based on actuation calibration technique. Two pilot tones (calibration signal) located on both sides of drive signal are applied to actuate the sense mode and estimate the frequency mismatch. Theoretical simulation and experiment result indicate the pilot tones should be located outside the frequency band between the sense mode and drive mode in order to fulfill mode match. Swept frequency experiment demonstrates the mode-matching system can achieve 0.56Hz mismatch frequency between the sense mode and drive mode.

articleTitle: Research on Health Evaluation of Electronic Equipment Based on Fuzzy Decision
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Aiming at the state health evaluation of electronic equipment, fuzzy decision method is adopted to evaluate the degree of deterioration of its performance.First, the health parameters of the equipment are collected and analysed, and the fuzzy sets and weight sets are constructed. Secondly, according to the definition of equipment health grade, the evaluation set and evaluation matrix are constructed.Finally, a comprehensive evaluation result is obtained by calculating the maximum membership function.The simulation results of a power amplifier device on a ground station show that the above method can give intuitive and accurate state evaluation results.

articleTitle: Method of Anomaly Detection of Temperature Data in Vacuum Thermal Test Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to improve the degree of automation for the anomaly detection of Temperature Data in Vacuum Thermal Test, based on the similarities of the Temperature Data, a kind of Similarity Metric Algorithm named DTW-SBD is carried out and the optimal ranges of parameters are obtained. The Average Accuracy Rate of this algorithm is above 0.9. Based on the preceding algorithm, an Anomaly Detection method of Temperature Data is proposed, which can accurately identify four kinds of typical abnormal modes in Vacuum Thermal Test. This method achieves the similar effect as manual detection.

articleTitle: A Robust Geomagnetic Matching Algorithm Based on L1 Norm
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The outliers in geomagnetic measured data can seriously impact the geomagnetic matching results and greatly affect the geomagnetic matching efficiency. A geomagnetic matching algorithm which has anti-outlier ability and can adjust the displacement, heading and zoom errors is investigated in this paper. Firstly, L1 norm is introduced for robust estimation. Secondly, by combining the affine transformation, the correlate criterion and the Taylor series expansion for geomagnetic information, a mathematical expression of the displacement, heading and zoom errors is obtained. Thirdly, according to L1 norm weight function and the mathematical expression, the robust target function is acquired. Then the geomagnetic matching problem is converted to the solutions of nonlinear equations to minimize the function. Finally, Broyden iteration is applied to implement the novel algorithm. Simulation results show that the matching error of the novel algorithm is decreased to 31.08% to the conventional iterative contour matching algorithm when the outlier is 31nT. Meanwhile, the position error of the novel algorithm is 0.0195° while the conventional iterative contour matching algorithm fails to match when the outlier is 310nT.

articleTitle: Automatic Size Measurement Equipment for Aluminum Pipe Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of poor precision, low efficiency and un-uniform standard in traditional artificial detection methods, an automatic measurement equipment based on machine vision is developed for aluminum pipe joint.In this paper, the solution is discussed in following three parts: firstly, a novel mechanical motion control platform is designed for the detection of aluminum pipe joint; secondly, an improved median filtering algorithm is proposed to improve the measurement speed; finally, efficient image segmentation and interval selection algorithms are proposed to calculate the sizes of aluminum pipe accurately. The test results show that the system can achieve high-precision and real-time measurement for aluminum pipe size.

articleTitle: Liquid Atomization Experiment on Pulse Combustion Spray Drying
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Based on the discussing of atomizing mechanism, liquid atomization experiments were carried out in the tailpipe of a Helmholtz-type pulse combustor. An optical analyzer was used for measuring the mean diameters of atomized droplets and their distribution. The effects of liquid viscosity on atomized droplet size and size distribution were investigated and analyzed. The results indicated that the droplet-size distribution is approximately a normal distribution. The range of the droplets' Sauter mean diameter is between 53 and 76 μm. The pulsating gas flow from the pulse combustor can be used to atomize liquid or slurry without a nozzle, and the atomizing effect can meet the spray drying requirements.

articleTitle: Research of Railway Signal Detecting Method Based on dsPIC
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: For the safety requirements of railway transport, this paper proposes a detection method of railway signal based on dsPIC30f6014. On the basis of briefly introduced dsPIC30f6014, putting forward the method of estimating wheel position, completing fault diagnosis of sensor and the evaluation of sensor capability, show the hardware design, software design and methods of experiment. The experimental results show that this method can complete the function of railway signal detection real-time and accurately.

articleTitle: Context Based Adaptive First 1 Bit Run-Length Image Bit-Plane Coding Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to improve the performance of First 1 bit run-length bit-plane coding algorithm (F1-run), we employed a context estimate based method to adaptive adjust coding parameters, including run-length threshold value and k parameter of Exp-Golomb coding, context was estimated here by counting bit method to predict the probability of bit equal to 0. Proposed algorithm has retained the advantage of efficiency and parallelization. As the context predict process need not to access the neighbor pixels, proposed algorithm retained independence of pixels in coding process, which lead to the benefit of less buffering and more parallelization. The simulation result showed that the proposed algorithms performed well and reduced 0.12bit/pixel than original algorithm in loss-less compressing, which was close to JPEG2000.In loss-compressing experiment, proposed algorithms performed better than original F1-Run and CCSDS-IDC algorithm, slightly better than SPIHT as using INT97 DWT, and close to JPGE2000.

articleTitle: An On-Orbit Initial Alignment Method for Reusable Spacecraft with INS Star Sensor and GPS
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Many countries have been focusing on developing reusable spacecraft. For on-orbit alignment of reusable spacecraft, attitude determination is a vital problem. When developing a navigation system with an Inertial navigation system (INS) and star tracker, the misalignment between the two systems must be estimated so that measurements from both systems can be converted to a common reference frame. An innovative on-orbit alignment method for reusable spacecraft is proposed in this paper. This method utilizes Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) to estimate navigation errors and IMU biases, as well as the misalignment angle between INS and star tracker. The simulation results show that with good estimation of the misalignment angle between INS and star tracker, the positioning and orientation accuracy of INS/Star tracker integrated navigation system is greatly improved, so the method is effective and suitable for reusable space craft.

articleTitle: Thermal Insulation Design of the Optical Measurement Device Used in Liquid Oxygen Tank
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Based on the characteristics of low temperature and strong oxidation of liquid oxygen, a new temperature control method is proposed for optical measurement device in liquid oxygen medium. In order to ensure the temperature of the optical system satisfied the design requirements, the polyurethane is used as insulation materials and the heat-insulating is considered for the initial part design to increase the thermal resistance between optical system and the outside environment (passive thermal control). At the same time, the method of heating the optical lens with an electric heating film is adopted for active thermal control. According to the heat transfer theory, we analyze the heat transmission patterns and the heat influencing factors of the optical system. Making the finite element model of the optical measurement device on the ANSYS Workbench software, and simulate the heat transmission for different thickness and heating power. The result shows that the design of the optical measurement device is satisfied when the thickness of the insulating layer is 20mm, and the heating power is 19W.

articleTitle: The Research on Security Mechanisms of Struts2 Framework
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Struts is used widely but is not under a security condition. To enhance the security of Struts2, the paper focuses on Security Mechanisms and do a research on the principle of it. Drawbacks of Security Mechanisms are analyzed along with the analysis about some exploits of RCE vulnerabilities. And common and fatal drawbacks are got.

articleTitle: Knowledge Discovery from Categorical Data Based on Structured Partial Ordered Attribute Diagram
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Knowledge discovery is the process of extracting useful and understandable patterns in data. A knowledge discovery process involves different learning methods in the data mining step or different model visualization methods in the post-processing phase. Among them, categorical data clustering has attracted much attention recently. While many algorithms for clustering categorical data have been proposed, some have low clustering accuracy while others have high computational complexity. In this paper, a visualization method of structured partial ordered attribute diagram for clustering categorical data is proposed based on the formal concept analysis theory. The structured partial ordered attribute diagram is constructed based on covering operations. Knowledge can be extracted from the hierarchies and clusters in a structured partial ordered attribute diagram. The method is applied to a famous formal context in formal concept analysis and a categorical dataset in UCI Machine Learning Repository. The results show that the structured partial ordered attribute diagram provides a new way for visual knowledge mining.

articleTitle: Distributed Cooperative Multi-Spacecraft Configuration Control Using High Gain Observer
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper we investigate the cooperative configuration control problem for multi-spacecraft system with model uncertainties and external disturbances based on directed communication topology. The key methods are neural network, high gain observer, and backstepping technique. A distributed control algorithm with estimation of immeasurable variables is designed. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is effective and has a good performance in control performance.

articleTitle: Design of Satellite Borne DBF Multi-Beam Receiving System
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: DBF multi-beam phased array antenna has the advantage of high gain, wide coverage, so it can be used in satelite communication as userlink or inter-satellite link. In this paper, we propose a DBF multi-beam receiving system, this system works in Ka band, with phased array antenna and receiver integrated. This system consists of a 4 element antenna array, a multi-channel RF module, a DBF and communication module, and a testing system. It can generate 16 beams and demodulate the receiving signals simultaneously. The design methodology and test results of the system is discussed in the paper. The results shows that all of the functions and performances are in accordance with the design.

articleTitle: Moving Targets Detection in Sonar with Finite-Rate-of-Innovation Sampling Principle
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With the advent of high-resolution sonar system, high rate A/D conversion has increasingly been required under Shannon-Nyquist sampling theorem, leading to a torrent of samples, which exceeds the current transmission capacity. Thus, downsampling at the front-end is required. The recently developed finite rate of innovation (FRI) theorem allows sampling signals characterized by a finite number of parameters at the degrees of freedom per unit of time of the signal. In this paper, we propose a minimal rate single-channel sampling and reconstruction scheme in sonar system, which can be used to detect targets sparsely in the time-frequency region. Firstly, the mathematical model of sonar echo is established. Secondly, a set of Fourier series coefficients of the sonar echo is obtained using FRI sampling framework. Finally, a recovery approach based on Doppler focusing is proffered to recover the unknowns of multi-highlights of one target simultaneously, which splits the time-delay estimation and Doppler frequency estimation. The simulation results indicate that the unknowns of targets can be recovered successfully in complex target and reverberation scenes. It addresses the real problem of high rate sampling and digital processing of sonar echo.

articleTitle: Image Threshold Segmentation Based on an Improved Bee Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Image segmentation means that the image is divided into specific and unique regions. There are many existing image segmentation methods, and the threshold-based segmentation method is widely applied because of its easy implementation, simplicity and high efficiency. In this paper, artificial bee colony algorithm is applied to image threshold segmentation. Kapur entropy is used as a fitness function, the artificial bee colony algorithm is improved through the adaptive scaling factor. The search area is enlarged through the large-scale factor, the neighborhood search scope is reduced through the small-scale factor and the search efficiency is enhanced. Finally, by comparing the PSNR values of the image, the algorithm has a good segmentation effect and good convergence performance.

articleTitle: System-Level Simulation Framework for Ultra-Dense Network
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In ultra-dense network (UDN), the dense deployment of small cells can effectively improve the network throughput. In order to analyze the performance of UDN system, we propose a system-level UDN simulation framework in this paper, including system architecture, channel model and site model. Unlike previous works, we give a complete simulation flow. The path loss model shows that Line-of-Sight (LOS) propagation probability is bigger than LTE. A modified Poisson point process (PPP) model is proposed to simulate a dynamic base-station deployment process which approximates the realistic scenario. In addition, considering the utilization rate of small cells (SCs) and the proportion of SCs users, we analyze the density of SCs with different association strategies. Based on the proposed framework, simulation results show that if the density of SCs is less than a threshold, we can obtain a linear gain of system throughput while keeping the average throughput increasing.

articleTitle: Study on the Key Factors Affecting the Long-Term Stability of SINS
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Trapdown Inertial Navigation System (SINS) has gained more and more extensive application in aircraft control system. However, the long-term stability of strapdown inertial navigation system (SINS) has brought great inconvenience to routine maintenance and operation. In this paper, the present situation and development trend of the long-term stilility performance of SINS are introduced. The main causes of the long-term stability of strapdown inertial navigation system are analyzed, the key factors affecting the long - term stability of SINS are summarized, and the main technical solutions are put forward.

articleTitle: Fault Attack against Lightweight Block Cipher Based on Cube Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper analyzed the principle of how the lightweight block cipher designed and selected the SIMECK 32/64 algorithm to evaluate its security by the method of algebraic fault attack. Firstly, given the situation that the fault injected might occur failure when spreading along with encryption, and analysis the causes that why the fault failed. Then run the cube test on the state which was injected by the single-bit fault base on the method of cube analysis, which is order to construct the differential characteristics table of ciphertext to determine the location of fault injected. The results show that the success rate of determining the location of fault injected can all reach 100% when the depth of injection fd<; 4 if the single-bit fault injected into the right register, and the rate could still reach 94.4% when the fd increased to 5.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Overlay Dynamic Spectrum Access Based on SMSE Framework
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Cognitive radio (CR) and dynamic spectrum access (DSA) are the effective ways to solve the spectrum congestion problem. Three kinds of basic DSA approaches are respectively dynamic exclusive use, open sharing and hierarchical access. The hierarchical access model is perhaps the most compatible with solving the current spectrum congestion problem. So, in this paper, we will set up an overlay DSA system which is an effective approach of the hierarchical access model. Firstly, we make use of the spectrally modulated spectrally encoded (SMSE) framework to generate OFDM waveforms for the secondary user (SU) which can be considered as the overlay waveform. Then we use the signal which is generated by the walkie-talkie to access the overlay DSA system as a primary user (PU) or an interference signal. The universal software radio peripheral (USRP) and spectrum analyzer are used to generate and analyze the power spectrum density (PSD) of the coexistence of a SU and a PU or an interference signal. The experimental result demonstrates that the overlay DSA system can achieve the function of turning off the sub-carriers corresponding to the frequency of the PU. It also shows that the system can greatly improve the efficiency of the spectrum utilization due to dynamically allocate the spectrum.

articleTitle: Research on the Digital Development for a Satellite Bus Cable
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper study and discuss software and key joints in digital cable development of satellite platform. A digital design software architecture is presented. It specifies for key joints of the development. This method is practiced to prove that the satellite digital cable network can enhance the design capability of satellite production-oriented, guarantee product quality, increase efficiency, easy to manufacture and install.

articleTitle: Dimensionality Reduction on Grassmannian: A Good Practice
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Representing images and videos as linear subspaces for visual recognition has made a great success which benefits from the Riemannian geometry named the Grassmann manifold. However, subspaces in vision are high-dimensional, which leads to a high computational expense and limited applicability of existing techniques. In this paper, we propose a generalized model to learn a lower-dimensional and more discriminative Grassmann manifold from the high dimensional one through an orthonormal projection for a better classification. We respect the Riemannian geometry of the Grassmann manifold and search for this projection directly from one Grassmann manifold to another face-to-face without any additional transformations. In this natural geometry-aware way, any metric on the Grassmann manifold can be resided in our model theoretically. We have combined different metrics with our model and the learning process can be treated as an unconstrained optimization problem on a Grassmann manifold. Experiments on several action datasets demonstrate that our approach can improve a more favorable accuracy over the state-of-the-art algorithms.

articleTitle: Droplet Motion Analysis in Space Rocket Engine Combustion Chamber Based on Gas Flow Similarity
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The previous research paid less attention to the similarity characteristics of gas liquid two-phase flow in space rocket engine thrust chamber, and the droplet motion analysis based on gas flow had never been carried out. In this paper, firstly a numerical analysis model about gas flow in thrust chamber is built and the gas flow similarity is deduced, then a dimensionless calculation expression is promoted to describe the gas flow velocity. Secondly, a numerical analysis model about droplet motion in thrust chamber is built, taking the gas flow as input. Lastly, the effects of the combustion length diameter ratio and outlet throat area ratio on the droplet trajectory and velocity are discussed. The analysis method, that is given in this paper and used to investigate into the droplet motion and gas flow in space rocket engine thrust chamber, has certain reference value for space rocket engine test and engineering design.

articleTitle: Dense Optical Flow Estimation from RGB-D
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Optical flow is a key problem in computer vision with tremendous potential applications in many fields, such as action recognition, autonomous navigation and manipulation. In this paper, we propose a dense optical flow estimation approach for objects of interest. In order to improve the accuracy of the optical flow estimation, the intensity and depth data from the RGB-D sensor are used for doing object segmentation. Afterwards, a homography based method assuming the surface to be planar is applied to obtain dense optical flow for each segment. Several experiments have been performed to evaluate the proposed method. The results demonstrate the validity of our approach.

articleTitle: Optimum Strategy of Reference Emitter Placement for Dual-Satellite TDOA and FDOA Localization
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: An optimum strategy of reference emitter placement for dual-satellite time difference of arrival (TDOA) and frequency difference of arrival (FDOA) localization based on particle swarm optimization is proposed to improve localization accuracy. Firstly Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRLR) of dual-satellite TDOA and FDOA localization system with ephemeris error and system error is derived. Then, the optimum strategy of reference emitter placement is transformed to multidimensional constraint optimization problem by using CRLB as the criterion for performance of dual-satellite TDOA and FDOA localization system. Finally, optimum strategy of reference emitter placement is obtained by using particle swarm optimization (PSO) to solve the target function. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method can derive optimum strategy of reference emitter placement validly. Besides, when the optimum strategy of reference emitter placement is applied, only two reference emitters are demanded to eliminate the effect of ephemeris error and system error on localization accuracy.

Author Keywords: Optimum Strategy of Reference emitter Placement

articleTitle: Frame Synchronization Word Identification of Link Layer Protocol Based on N-ECLAT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: There are many types of spatial data link layer protocols and different frame structures. To achieve effective framing and resolution of the protocol, we must first solve the problem of identifying synchronization words. In this paper ,a frame synchronization word recognition algorithm for link layer protocol based on N-ECLAT algorithm is proposed. The algorithm combines the structure characteristics of link layer protocol and the vertical mining of Eclat algorithm. By introducing the parameter N, the synchronization word can be accurately identified, which lays the foundation for the identification of the CCSDS spatial data link layer protocol. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the algorithm and the accuracy of protocol identification.

articleTitle: Design of Satellite Automatic Test System Based on Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With the rapid development of aerospace technology, the satellite is becoming more and more complicated. The satellite test tasks are facing with serious challenges, such as complex test requirements and long test cycle. Also manual test cannot guarantee the adequacy of test requirements, completeness and reusability. In this paper a satellite automatic test system is designed based on the data transmission feature in satellite components. This automatic test system contains a formal language to describe the process of satellite test, a way automatically generates the test process and automatically interpret the results. The design has certain guiding significance to the industrialization of satellite automatic test.

articleTitle: Difficulty and Typicality-Based Problem Recommendation Algorithm Implementation and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With the increasing popularity of "online learning", a method of finding effective learning materials from massive resources is urgently needed. By setting the "problems" in the online learning system as an example, this paper analyzes the "difficulty" of learning materials and proposes a computational method of difficulty. Then, based on the difficulty of problems and the concept of "typicality" in psychology, an algorithm suitable for problem recommendation is designed. The comparative experiments based on the actual data prove that this algorithm is superior to the existing methods both in the recommendation effectiveness and the time efficiency.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of Link Layer Controller for IEEE1394 Isochronous Transmission Mode
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: According to the requirement of the localization of IEEE 1394 interface chip, the function of IEEE 1394 link layer is analyzed. Based on the isochronous transmission mode, the system structure, module division and data transmission process of IEEE 1394 link layer controller are designed. The logic process design of memory module, cyclic timer module, receiver module and cyclic monitor module in the system is carried out through the state machine. After the controller is comprehensively described through the hardware description language, the software simulation and system debugging function verification are carried out. The verification results show that the IEEE1394 transmission mode link layer controller is stable and can complete high-speed data transmission.

articleTitle: The Research of PSpice Simulation of Current Sampling Circuit for Great Torque Reaction Flywheel
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Towards the requirements of attitude adjusted rapidly control for great torque flywheel which as the main actuator structure of satellites, this paper illustrates the solution for current sampling for the motor driver of flywheel.To improve the performance of the torque control mode for flywheel, further more the schmitt trigger circuit of overcurrent protection hysteresis and the optimized design of motor current sampling circuit has been proposed by the parameter sweep analysis of PSpice of OrCAD Capture, then the results of monte carlo and worst case analysis which accord with theory have been verified. The designed flywheel prototype has been carried on experiment which yields satisfying results. The prototype include optimized sampling circuit is built to improve the dynamic performance of current loop and the ability of retaining the disturbance from motor noise, the related experimentation results validate the correctness of optimized design measures.

articleTitle: Research on Eccentricity and Longitude Control of Geostationary Satellites
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The longitude of geostationary satellites is continuously drifting and oscillating under the impact of perturbation forces. This paper researched a periodic East-West Station-Keeping strategy to control the eccentricity and longitude simultaneously. Station-keeping elements is introduced to describe the motion of GEO satellites. The perturbed motion of these elements is analyzed. The ideal motion of drift rate vector is designed based on the minimum-maximum principle. Considering of the effect of solar radiation perturbation, the eccentricity lag sun vector strategy is designed to control the eccentricity vector. Numeric simulation verified the strategy can keep the longitude within predefined range by periodic maneuvers.

articleTitle: Stochastic Inequalities for Mx/G/1 Retrial Queues with Bernoulli Feedback and Second Optional Service
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The retrial queue with batch arrivals and feedback customers is considered in our paper. The server provides service to customers one by one. Every customer may select a second phase of service after his essential service, may leave the system or may retry his service, in which case he joins the retrial queue. Our goal is to get some stochastic comparison properties with respect to the strong stochastic ordering and convex ordering. Our conclusions lead some insensitive bounds for our queueing stationary distribution.

articleTitle: Prediction Model for Information Transmission Performance of Publish/Subscribe Systems with Heterogeneous Servers
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A novel prediction model for information trans-mission performance is presented in this paper, which is suitable for publish/subscribe systems with heterogeneous servers. Firstly, a uniform business logic model is developed by analyzing the principle of several typical types of publish/subscribe distributed systems. In addition, a mathematical model named MMPP(2)/G/1 cascaded queuing model is proposed by introducing heterogeneous server weighting factors into classical queuing model and Markov modulated Poisson process, which can eliminate iteration errors of the queuing model. The proposed prediction model is fully verified by carrying out a series of experiments in an Internet test platform. The results of the experiments illustrate that the proposed prediction model can achieve a higher prediction accuracy than the traditional model.

articleTitle: Government Subsidies on Production Efficiency of Family Farms
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Founded on the data of fixed observation points in rural areas in China in 2011, a total of 9667 valid family farm samples were selected and analyzed by the Tobit model to evaluate the effect of government subsidy on family farms from a policy perspective. Economic benefits. The results show that there is a significant positive correlation between government subsidy and rice production efficiency on family farms, that is, rice production efficiency will be further improved with the increase of the subsidy amount. In view of this, we should further perfect the financing system and agricultural insurance system for family farms, and promote the construction of agricultural infrastructure by introducing the new public infrastructure fund model such as PPP model and further agricultural socialized production services.

articleTitle: An Embedded Control Scheduling Technology for Improving Real-Time Data Acquisition Integrity
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Due to the particularity of the real-time data acquisition, traditional task schedule method does not meet the integrity of real-time data acquisition system. This paper studies real-time scheduling theory, proposed new task scheduling model and the time-chip scheduling algorithm based on sync signal. According to relative theory to build scheduler, hardware platform to achieve imbedded scheduling technology, The experiment show that the time-chip scheduling algorithm based on sync signal is effective and can improve the integrity of real-time data acquisition.

articleTitle: Research on Constructing Surrogate Model of Rocket Aerodynamic Discipline Using Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to decrease the long time consuming of the aerodynamic numerical calculation in the multi-discipline designing of the rocket, this paper proposed a surrogate model of rocket aerodynamic based on extreme learning machine, and described the process to construct the surrogate model in detail. Based on aerodynamic surrogate model of a rocket, this paper evaluated the precision of the surrogate model with a small learning sample, and it proved that this method is very feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Implementation of Pulse Compression Algorithm Based on Multicore CPU
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: To realize real-timely detection of low altitude aircraft target, this paper introduces a parallel model based on multicore CPU aiming at pulse compression (PC). Eight cores are utilized to process parallel intensive task. The detailed implementation of pulse compression (PC) algorithm is introduced in this paper. The result indicates that this design meets the requirement of real-timely pulse compression with one echo sample.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of an Intelligent Equivalent Equipment for Missile Initiating Devices Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: To solve the problem of detecting for Missile Initiating Devices (MID) before launching, an intelligent equivalent equipment based on Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) is designed and realized. The system adopts microchip EP3C16F256C8 and its peripheral circuit to equal to the electric detonator resistor while passage-testing. It also can be used to detect the sequence of electric information while signal testing. Through passage-testing, experiment of current timing and voltage timing shows that the electric detonator resistor value and the sequence width can meet the design requirement. The testing is investigated on the experimental platform. Also, the system has the advantages of high reliability, good maintenance and strong practicality. It can be widely promoted and applied.

articleTitle: Design of Spacecraft Attitude Control Physical Simulation System Based on New DSP Controller
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, the hardware and software experiment system of the large angle maneuver of the satellite attitude is designed and realized according to the requirement of the professional construction. The composition includes: single axis turntable, a nitrogen source, the new DSP controller, model simulator, router, multi-channel rechargeable power supply system and battery, fiber optic gyro, flywheel, jet system, computer and printer etc. Attitude maneuver control method is PD control. The controller uses DSP SEED-DEC28335. The control experiment program is developed by using C language. Its research characteristic is to realize the wireless data communication between PC and DSP. The CCS compiler v5.5 and the operating system Windows 8-32 bits. The experimental results show that the large angle attitude maneuver simulation of the satellite based on flywheel is accomplished. The rotating angle range of the turntable is ±90 degrees. The accuracy of maneuver is less than 0.5 degrees and meet the simulation mission requirements.

articleTitle: Trajectory Privacy Protection Method through Active Points Hiding
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The use of individual trajectory information may result in serious invasions of personal privacy or leakage of personal data. Existing trajectory privacy protection methods are designed to protect the whole trajectory rather than to protect sensitive or frequently visited location points, which can cause additional information loss. This paper proposes an approach to trajectory privacy protection which targets active point information. Active information points are replaced with an anonymous region and silent information points directly published to protect the trajectory, which minimizes the distortion of trajectory data as well as the likelihood that personal information is leaked. The proposed method takes into account the diversity of sensitive attributes, restricts the type of region, and minimizes the quantity of the cloak area to protect privacy. The proposed method outperforms other similar methods in terms of privacy protection level and data utility.

articleTitle: An Initial Attitude Determination Method for Geomagnetic Field and Gyro Data Fusion with Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper presents an initial attitude determination algorithm using a magnetometer and gyroscopes. Firstly, it measures the geomagnetic field vectors in spacecraft's body-fixed frame (BFF) at two different points (point a and b with the corresponding BBF described as BFFA and BFFB) on orbit track and calculates their theoretical projections in reference frame (RF) with the international geomagnetic field model (IGRF). Secondly, the algorithm utilizes gyro rate integration to calculate the relative quaternion that rotates the spacecraft's BBF from BFFA to BFFB. Thirdly, it converts the coordinate of the first measured vector from BBFA to BBFB with the relative quaternion. Finally, utilizing two unparalleled vectors with their projections in RF and BFFB, the spacecraft's attitude at point b is estimated. The estimation results are directly influenced by measurement noise and by gyro drift but is still accurate enough as initial input for Kalman Filter (KF), which is sensitive to initial estimation errors. Simulations are carried out that demonstrate the efficiency of the algorithm in the particular case of high initial estimation errors.

articleTitle: Automation Control of Thermal Conductivity Measurement Process Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: An automation control program based on LabVIEW is designed to measure thermal conductivity of phase change material (PCM). The program is composed of file storage function of all test data and calculation results, temperature-controlled with only one heating plate or both heating plates, NI-DAQ-based data acquisition system, and steady state judgment system. During the testing procedure, the setting temperature is transmitted to heat plates while real-time parameters are read to the computer by using the Modbus protocol. When the temperature reach to stable state determined by the program automatically, the thermal conductivity of PCM is measured. The development of this automatic control program can realize the automatic test of thermal conductivity, and obtain the variation of temperatures and heat fluxes to research the phase change process in the future.

articleTitle: Unmanned Vehicle with Obstacle Avoidance Technology Based on Ultrasonic Ranging
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Automatic obstacle avoidance technology is one of the core technologies of the driverless car and intelligent robot. The aim I write this paper is that through the explosion of the obstacle avoidance technology can I gain referable hardware control equipments, relevant control software and basic data, and finally conclude a reasonable obstacle avoidance scheme which can be applied into the practice. The paper intend to use the caterpillar two drive car as the experimental subject, with the development board called ESP8266, utilize the ultrasonic sensor to measure the distance between the car and the obstacle. According to the distance to do the right obstacle avoidance strategy automatically. This article firstly illustrates the abroad development of the intelligent car with Automatic obstacle avoidance technology and introduce the consistent of this car which including hardware equipments and the software programs. I used the develop board ESP8266 as the development platform, placed the three ultrasonic sensors on the front side, right side and left side. And put a sound transducer to collect sound signal. So that the signal collected can be more integrated and comprehensive. Then I wrote a reasonable program about obstacle avoidance. According to the different situation the car will meet, I wrote five different strategies which are applied into five different environments. At last, in case that the car cannot do the obstacle avoidance. This car can be controlled by our mobile phones as well, which can enhance its functionality and usability. Tested by experiments, the car I invented can not only be controlled by human beings, but it can do the automatic obstacle avoidance without people as well. The car meets all the require of the scheme and achieves the aim of obstacle avoidance automatically. It can be well applied into practice.

articleTitle: Design of High Pressure Common-Rail System for a Large Power Diesel Engine Based on Simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to research the High Pressure Common- Rrail System(HPCRS) for a large power diesel engine. In this paper, based on establishing a physical and math model of the system, the control manner of Proportional oil-in Control for fuel pressure control has been discussed and framed; the structure of the fuel injection system which adapt to this control manner has been design. The real time control system of large power diesel engine simulation model has been established though the fuel system simulation software and Matlab/Simulink software; the effects of the structural parameters to common-rail pressure were simulated. Finally, the high pressure common-rail system for a large power diesel engine was designed. As the result, it is turned out that the common-rail fuel pressure controlled by the control manner of Proportional oil-in Control and the strategy of PID could be setup less than 0.42s and stabilize by the range of 3% under manifold enactment pressure and the consistency of injection meet the challenge.

Author Keywords: the real time control of the common—rail pressure

articleTitle: A Sub-Nyquist Spectrum Sensing Method Based on Joint Recovery of Distributed MWCs
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The recently proposed sub-Nyquist spectrum sensing method based on Modulated Wideband Converter (MWC) significantly relieves sampling pressure from wideband spectrum sensing of cognitive radio. However, the sensing success rate of a single receiving node consisted of MWC is far from satisfactory due to the influences of the hidden terminal problem and so on. In this paper, we present a distributed sub-Nyquist wideband spectrum sensing method using joint recovery technique based on multiple MWCs. The proposed sensing method can improve the sensing performance with the increase of node numbers by making full use of the joint sparse structure across multiple received signals and the diversity of sensing matrices. Numerical experiments show that, compared with separate sensing method, the proposed can enhance the sensing performance in terms of success rate, and it even can achieve a success when the separate sensing for each node fails.

articleTitle: Fault Detection for Uncertain Nonlinear Stochastic Systems with Successive Data Packet Loss
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Aiming to the fault detection problem of stochastic systems with successive data packet loss under networked environments, a model under consideration of parameter uncertainty and randomly occurring nonlinearity is set up. The random characteristics of random occurring nonlinearity and data packet loss are described by using two random sequences which are independent of each other and obey Bemoulli distribution. A sufficient condition for the existence of the fault detection filter is obtained according to Lyapunov stability theory and stochastic analysis techniques and the fault detection problem is solved by transforming into convex optimization problem.

articleTitle: Research on the Key Technology of Selective Symbolic Execution
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The security of software is threaten by the vulnerability from itself. In recent years, the testing of the binary software is becoming more and more important, and researchers have also put forward many analyzing methods to find the vulnerability of the softwares. This paper studies several kinds of the analyzing methods on binary software, and on this basis, mainly study the development of the Selective Symbolic Execution(S2E) platform. Moreover, this paper tests the technical effect of this technology. The experiment results show that this method is effective in finding the vulnerabilities of the software.

articleTitle: Bond Graph Based Modeling and Simulation of Marine Condenser
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Condenser is one of the key equipments of marine steam power system. In order to build a marine condenser model which can give consideration to both simulation accuracy and computational efficiency, the mathematical models of condenser shell and cooling water flow are analyzed by lumped parameter method and distributed parameter method respectively. Based on bond graph theory, the characteristic modeling of a marine condenser is presented. After that, the system model is built on 20-sim platform and the simulation analysis is carried out. The validity of the condenser model is verified by experimental data. The simulation result errors of the condenser vacuum and condensate water temperature were 3.5% and 4.7% respectively. Furthermore, the dynamic response of the condenser under the disturbance of cooling water flow rate and temperature is studied, which provides a reference for the optimization of the control strategy of the condenser.

articleTitle: Applications of OPC UA Client Server Mode on EPICS Researches
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
