abstract: The Experimental Physics and Industrial Control System (EPICS) is a standard development tool and middleware for the Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) of large scientific projects. If EPICS exchanges data with different SCADA, the problem need to be solved by a communication specification. We choose Object Linking and Embedding for Process Control Unified Architecture (OPC UA) Client Server mode as the data exchange interface between EPICS and other SCADA. In this paper we use LabVIEW to develop related applications and test them in simulated industrial Ethernet. The test results meet the data exchange requirements between different SCADA, and the method provides an effective solution for the data exchange problems of large scientific projects.

Author Keywords: Experimental Physics and Industrial Control System (EPICS)
Object Linking and Embedding for Process Control Unified Architecture (OPC UA)

articleTitle: A Preliminary Study on Modularization Design of General Computer Elective Courses in University
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In recent years, competition in higher education is becoming more and more fierce, which is reflected in the optimization of professional structure and the acceleration of transformation and the vigorous promotion of innovation and entrepreneurship education. China's higher education has entered a new stage of development. In order to meet the new trend of the development of higher education and in accordance with the actual conditions of our university, we have set up the "Computer Programming" General Education Courses module in the fields of General Knowledge II and General Knowledge III, aiming at highlighting the overall quality of students and meeting the demand of individualized development of students, open up boundaries of General Knowledge II and general knowledge III. While deepening the reform of general education, it also lays a good foundation for our school to cultivate useful talents who are adapted to the development of economic and social, enhance the employment competitiveness of our graduates, and improve the quality of our school.

articleTitle: Simple Formula for Eliminating Grating Lobes in EMAT Phased Arrays
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: EMAT phased arrays are advantageous compared with piezoelectric transducer (PZT) phased arrays because no direct contact with the specimen is needed. The performance of phased arrays can be improved as the spacing distance of the array elements increases. However, for avoiding the grating lobes, the array element spacing should be less than half the wavelength is usually accepted. In this paper, to eliminate the grating lobes, a simple formula is proposed to calculate the spacing distance of the array elements. The formula shows that the array element spacing is greater than half the wavelength can be used in some cases, e.g., the steering angle is relatively small. The validity of the formula is verified by simulated results and experimental results.

articleTitle: The Development of Linear Temperature Distribution Online Measurement Instrument Based on Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to meet the measurement needs of linear temperature distribution in fast moving objects with high temperature, this paper developed a high-speed linear temperature distribution online measurement instrument based on Raspberry Pi micro-controller which provided intelligent embedded development platform. Advanced uncooled PbSe detector, interface development algorithm and background radiation elimination technique are applied to realize the real-time display of the linear temperature distribution. The instrument has been experimental calibrated and the experimental results demonstrate that the system can recognize the measurement of linear temperature distribution accurately and rapidly.

articleTitle: Content Filtering-Based Data Distribution for Middleware Joint Test Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Data distribution management module based on content filtering combined content-based filtering algorithm and a parallel distribution algorithm, which can complete content filter in the process of running the system as well as reduce waiting time of subscribe nodes, so this method is suitable for applications where the requirement of data filtering capability is high. A test system is built based on joint test platform to verify the function of the software. The results of the test indicate that this software is characterized with complete function, stable performance. The data distribution management module can provide a flexible expression of interested data, reduce the network load, and improve the efficiency of data transmission. The method has the wide application for the middleware joint test platform.

articleTitle: Anatomical-Connectivity Based Parcellation of Hippocampus and Medial Temporal Lobe Epilepsy Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Unilateral medial temporal lobe epilepsy (mTLE) has similar symptoms in clinic. Previous studies indicate that it's difficult to find significant differences when comparing the structure of left and right mTLE directly. As is known to all, hippocampus sclerosis often causes mTLE. Therefore, it may be essential to detect the internal structure of hippocampus (HC) to confirm the lateralization of mTLE focus. We tracked fibers between each voxel of HC to each voxel of the whole brain by Diffusion Tensor Imaging and divided each side of the HC into 2 to 4 subregions based on anatomical connectivity (AC). Then, AC comparisons (HC and HC subregions to the target regions) were made between left mTLE, right mTLE and normal controls pair-wisely for classification. Feature fusion was made to elevate the classification accuracy. With use of the leave-one-out cross-validation strategy, the Support Vector Machine classifier could achieve accuracy of 81.6% for left mTLE versus controls, 79.6% for right mTLE versus controls, and 83.7% for left mTLE versus right mTLE. Therefore, AC based parcellation of hippocampus can be applied into clinic to find more specific focus of mTLE.

articleTitle: Spatial Target Position Calibration and Combination Measurement Using Monocular CCD Camera
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Industrial monocular area CCD camera is now playing a remarkable role in the fields of spatial target position and velocity measurement. To overcome the measurement nonlinearities and the process uncertainties, and to improve the precision of target positioning, a set of triangle combination target is employed, the calibration principles of Zhang is utilized, and the idea of combination measurement is proposed by using three focal spots as cooperative target. The experiment shows the position measuring error can be decreased within 2 magnitude, and the effectiveness of such methods is verified.

articleTitle: An Automatic Exploit Generation Method Based on Symbolic Execution
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Return-to-dl-resolve [3] is a general exploit technology that can break through complex protection mechanisms. However, it's hard to be employed for security researchers must understand the principle of ELF dynamic linking and construct shell-code manually. This paper proposes an automatic method to generate Return-to-dl-resolve exploit based on symbolic execution, which provides a symbolic execution environment for ELF executable files, constrains symbolic program state at crash point and solves the constraints through constraint solver, then implements a system called R2d1AEG to generate Return-to-dl-resolve ShellCode automatically. The experimental results show that R2dlAEG system can generate shell-code more quickly and can break both NX and ASLR.

articleTitle: Secure Data Aggregation Algorithm Based on Trust in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs), which have been widely used in many areas, are highly susceptible to external attacks. Therefore, it is essential to develop a secure way to aggregate the data in WSNs. In this paper, a secure data aggregation algorithm based on trust (SDABT) is proposed to improve the security of WSNs. The cluster head determines the comprehensive trust of the ordinary node which is composed of communication trust, data trust and energy trust. Then, the comprehensive trust is used to identify the malicious node and used as weight to aggregate the intra-cluster data. The base station aggregates the data from cluster heads in a similar way. To verify the performance of SDABT, the simulation compares it with the traditional arithmetic mean algorithm, and the result shows that SDABT has significantly smaller mean-square error (MSE).

articleTitle: Research on the Internal Mechanism of Enterprise Knowledge Base Operation
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: As a complex system, the operation Enterprise Knowledge base is composed of four elements which are related: control, power, guarantee and feedback. This author applies Boolean algebra theory, constructs the matrix model to reveal the interrelationship among its constituent elements, and to explore its operational mechanism.

articleTitle: The Influence of Dip Angle on UXO Response
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, the transient electromagnetic (TEM) response of an 82mm mortar shell is calculated and measured based on the orthogonal dipole model. The influence of dip angle on target response is analyzed in detail. The theoretical results for time domain response indicate that both the amplitudes and decay rates of the responses change significantly with the dip angle, which means that the time domain response at a certain point is inadequate to identify a target. The z-component of the survey line response is axisymmetric while the x-component is center symmetric. The symmetry of both responses gets worse with the increase of the dip angle. Besides, the symmetric center of x-component and symmetrical axis of z-component will also shift to the right. The measured response agrees well with the calculated one for the low dip angle. If the dip angle reaches 900, the amplitude difference between the calculated and the measured response will be up to 50%, which means the dipole model is no longer suitable.

Author Keywords: time domain response, survey line response

articleTitle: Detection of Android Malicious Obfuscation Applications Based on Multi-Class Features
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In recent years, obfuscation technology is more and more widely utilized by Android applications (apps). Legitimate app developers employ this technology to protect their intellectual property. However, malicious app (malapp) authors obfuscate their apps to increase the difficulty of reverse-analysis-engineer and to evade signature-based detection. Static analysis method is the main approach to detect malapps. Unfortunately, many static analysis techniques are easily thwarted by obfuscation technology. How to detect obfuscated malapps effectively is thus a big challenge. In this work, we construct a model that detects obfuscated malapps, including obfuscation detection and malapp detection. The module of obfuscation detection extracts the identifier names of classes and methods of apps as features, employing n-gram to generate a fixed-length feature vector for each app. Then it applies Support Vector Machine (SVM) for classifying apps into obfuscation or non-obfuscation. In term of the module of malapp detection, we firstly extract many kinds of features from the APK (Android package) file with static analysis technology, such as Permission, Intent and so on. Then we use SVM to evaluate the performance of this module. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our methods. The accuracy of obfuscation detection reaches 90.91%, and the F-score arrives at 0.91. Besides, our malapp detection module can exactly detect 97.32% apps.

articleTitle: Output Kernel Learning for Multi-Output Regression
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Multi-output regression is the extension of single output learning, which requires one input sample to predict multiple real-valued output variables simultaneously. Previous studies have shown that multi-output learning yield to a better predictive performance, mostly because of the multivariate nature and the compound dependencies between the multiple feature/target variables. But these relationships are sometimes hard to detect directly, so it is a challenge to reveal the relationship between these input features and output variables. In order to improve the accuracy of the prediction, we propose a new kernel-based multi-output regression method to study the internal relationship between output variables, called KMOR. Our method is searched the framework between multiple functions and output into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space of vector-valued functions. It constructs input kernel by user-defined to represent the relationship between input characteristics and output kernel by auto-learned to represent the relationship between output variable, we also use an efficient alternating optimization to solve the objective function. We have done experiments on fifteen data sets from a variety of interesting application domains and use relative root mean squared error (RRMSE) as performance measurement, which show that this method can improve the accuracy of regression and has very fast convergence speed in comparison with state-of-the-art methods for multi-output regression.

articleTitle: Research on Low RCS Target Measurement Precision by High-Resolution Imaging Method
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In actual measurement process, it is not possible to erect metal ball directly on low RCS(Radar Cross Section) pylon, therefore verify measurement precision of low RCS target would be very difficult. In order to solve the problem, we will introduce a new verification method that metal ball is installed horizontally with foam column at the top of low scattering carrier, which is placed on low RCS pylon. However, because low scattering carrier and foam column, foam column and metal ball have a rather strong electromagnetic coupling effect, so the way of verification is hard to gain RCS of metal ball alone. So we can first diagnose position of scattering center of metal ball using high-resolution imaging method. Then, the scattering properties of metal ball would be refactored. Finally, RCS measurement and theoretical values of metal ball had been compared and analyzed. Experiments results show that RCS measurement of metal ball is close to its theoretical value in HH polarization and VV polarization at C frequency. The error is no more than 0.2dB at plus or minus two degrees.

articleTitle: Research on the GOOSE Message Communication Interface Based on DM9000AEP
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: GOOSE(Generic Objects Oriented Substation Event), the fast message communication mechanism brought up in IEC61850, is used for transmitting important real-time signals between intelligent electronic devices in substations. In the working process of smart substation, types of signals transmitted by the GOOSE message include the on-off signal, the blocking signal and the start-failure signal between different protective equipment. According to the instantaneity requirement of GOOSE message, fast Ethernet controller DM9000AEP is chosen to reach a date rate of 100Mbps. And using STM32F407ZGT6 as the CPU can control DM9000AEP. In this paper, the design of communication interface will be discussed, while the design of circuit and the software will be proposed. In the end of this paper, the communication function will be tested by Wireshark to prove the design is fast and reliable.

articleTitle: Position-Pose Measurement of Noncooperative Targets in Final Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Derelict satellites in space not only occupying orbit resource but tending to threaten safety of other normal operating satellites. On-orbit servicing mission including repair, refueling and removal of those satellites are needed urgently. To meet the needs of navigation to derelict satellites, a study of the position-pose measurement methods in final approach of space noncooperative targets is carried out. Combining with the theoretical research and demonstration project progress of the power country in spaceflight, the passive and active measurement methods are introduced and compared. Development trend of multi-sensor fusion based navigation is presented.

articleTitle: The Design of Indoor Mobile Robot Navigation System Based on UWB Location
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Aiming at the positioning and navigation system of indoor mobile robot, a fuzzy control method of indoor location navigation based on UWB communication technology is proposed. Firstly, based on the UWB radio signal, the mobile robot localization information is obtained by the twice triangular centroid localization algorithm, and the reactive fuzzy controller is used to realize the local path planning. An improved contour following method is proposed to make the mobile robot get out of the trap area quickly and reach the target. This method can effectively drive the mobile robot to reach the target in a complex and unknown environment with reasonable path. Finally, a fourwheel indoor mobile robot is taken as an example in the indoor environment of 10m × 10m. The experiment proves that the method can effectively drive the mobile robot to reach the target point in the unknown environment with the better path.

articleTitle: Research on Zero Detection Method of Sealing Ring in Cylinder Tightening Process Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Sealing ring, a key role in the technique of cylinder tightening which is widely used in modern manufacturing. The amount of compression of the sealing ring can affect quality of the whole cylinder tightening process. The zero point detection of the sealing ring is crucial to measure the compression volume of the sealing ring. In this paper, aiming at the zero point of sealing ring is difficult to detect, the cylinder tightening process is analyzed in detail. Moreover, the characteristics changes of the zero point of the sealing ring are analyzed during the whole process of cylinder tightening, and preprocessing data of the tightening process, the detection model of zero point is established based on support vector machine (SVM) classification algorithm. Using the particle swarm algorithm and MATLAB simulation to optimize parameters, finally the model verification is completed. The experimental results show that the classification algorithm can precisely detect the zero point of the sealing ring.

articleTitle: Research of Telecommunication Satellite Collaborative Design Method Based on Structured Data
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Document-based collaborative design is a common method in the process of telecommunication satellite development. The technical parameters are distributed in a large number of documents, so the parameters are relatively isolated and there is no unified design platform. Therefore, this method has several deficiencies in the efficiency and traceability of collaborative design, and it is hard to realize the homology, reusability and version control of data. This paper presents a collaborative design method which is driven by structured parameters and can support a fast and efficient design iteration. Transform the parameters from unstructured to structured ones based on the XML technology. XML is used as the parameters carrier, and then establish the mapping relation of the parameters. A collaborative design platform is constructed, and based on the mapping relation of the parameters, the satellite development process is decomposed into tasks, and the design process is driven and iterated by the automatic mapping of parameters. Finally, we developed the collaborative design platform based on the 3D EXPERIENCE of Dassault Systems and ran an example of satellite project design, the result shows that the structured data-based method can effectively solve the problems of documents-based method, therefore it can enhance the efficiency and quality of satellite design.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a MEMS Gravimeter for Lunar Missions
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Lunar gravity filed determines the optimization design of lunar orbiters and selections for landing sites. Direct gravity measurement by deploying high-resolution gravimeter is the only option for obtaining precise local gravity data rather than the satellite gravity survey. However, there are both light-weight and shock-resistance demands for payloads of lunar landers. Therefore, this paper proposes a Micro-Electromechanical-Systems (MEMS) based gravimeter for lunar gravity survey, taking the advantages of both light and robust. The basis of this MEMS lunar gravimeter is: a silicon-based spring-mass system performs as the gravity-sensitive element. When gravity varies with locations or time, the spring length will change and so the displacement of mass. Using the optical displacement measurement technology, the gravitational acceleration can be worked out. The gravity-sensitive element requires both an extremely low fundamental frequency for a higher sensitivity and lower noise floor and large spurious resonant frequencies for low cross-sensitivities. Shock-resistance structures are required for robustness of the gravimeter. According to the above design rationales, the gravity-sensitive element is designed and the finite element analysis software COMSOL has been used to simulate the vibration modes of the spring-mass system with the beam width varying from 20µm to 30µm. The gravimeter design with a beam width of 24µm has a fundamental frequency of 5Hz. The mechanical thermal noise can be worked out as 0.3µGal/Hz1/2 under the room temperature and atmosphere with a quality factor of 200. The equivalent noise of the optical displacement transducer is 10µGal/Hz1/2. Hence, the overall noise floor of the MEMS lunar gravimeter is 10µGal/Hz1/2, which can meet the requirement of precise measurement of lunar gravity field.

articleTitle: Research on Model Based Virtual Test Method for Spacecraft
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Spacecraft as a complex system, timely verification of its design and interface accuracy is an important means to improve the quality of system development. Virtual test technology can advance the baseline of test time for complex systems and become a research hotspot in spacecraft testing. This paper presents a virtual test method based on model detection. The window tree model was used to model the complex system. The state transition diagram was used as the system protocol to describe the correctness of the system behavior. Then the model-based virtual test of spacecraft was realized, and the virtual test platform was designed to realize the application of spacecraft.

articleTitle: A Novel Dynamic Spectrum Access Framework Based on MC-SMSE for Cognitive Radio Network
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The phenomenon of spectrum resources shortage is primarily caused by inefficient spectrum usage not spectrum availability. Dynamic spectrum access (DSA) is one technique to improve spectrum efficiency. Because most spectrum access algorithms need to sense the spectrum states of primary users in real time, this paper proposes a new spectrum access framework based on markov chain and spectrally modulated spectrally encoded (MC-SMSE) model without plenty of sensing time and energy. Firstly, markov chain is utilized to predict spectrum states in the future. Then, according to the predicted results, the spectrally modulated spectrally encoded model (SMSE) is applied to produce overlay and underlay waveform which is used for spectral access. The simulation results show the framework is a better solution to implement spectrum access. It can not only achieve reliable transmission, but also improve the utilization of spectrum at the same time.

articleTitle: Study on Patterns Recognition Method for Human Lower Limbs Based on SVM
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Extracting features from EMG signal and using pattern recognition method to predict the user's intended movement are the core parts of myoelcrtic prostheses control strategy. To extract more information about muscle contraction strategy. To extract more information about muscle contraction state and body movement from EMG signals by selecting some efficient feature parameters is one of the most important researches in Rehabilitation field. Since EMG signal is a weak signal and affected easily by various interference factors in real time applications, studying the effect of these factors on the performance in classifying intended movements can provide guidelines for future research.

articleTitle: Compressed Sensing Image Fusion Method Based on Region Variance
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Most of the traditional fusion algorithms are based on full sampling of the image. Compression sensing theory can use the sampling rate which is lower than the Nyquist sampling to sample the data, while achieving the integrity of the original data and accurate recovery. We introduced compression sensing in the framework of image fusion. After analyzing and comparing some fusion rules in image fusion, we proposed an improved fusion rule which combined the advantages of maximum method and linear weighted method based on the region variance. Simulation results on different type of images show that at the same sampling frequency, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional mean algorithm in terms of peak signal to noise ratio, mean square error, correlation coefficient etc.

articleTitle: Research on Smart Electric Energy Meters Manufacturing Technology Program Based on RFID
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In view of the manufacturing dispersion of smart electric energy meters in China, the products quality of various manufacturers varies greatly, the low efficiency of manual supervision and other problems, this paper describes a RFID-based smart electric energy meter monitoring technology program. RFID tags were implanted in smart electric energy meters, monitors and RFID readers were added to the production line, collected data was properly formulated. Smart electric energy meter production environment, equipment and key process steps were monitored. While uploading data to the monitoring system platform, key data was stored in meters. The whole process monitoring and full record of smart electric energy meter production process have formed, the efficiency of supervision has been improved, and the products quality has been guaranteed. At the same time, it makes up for the lack of data on manufacturing supervision in the life cycle management of smart electric energy meters.

articleTitle: Research of Integrated Guidance and Control for Missile in Pitch Channel
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Considering the modeling error caused by approximate linearization and ignoring couplings, we establish an integrated guidance and control model of missile in pitch channel. To be more closed to the real missile system, this paper builds elevator model. The adaptive dynamic surface control law is proposed to design the controller of this nonlinear system, which can avoid the computation explosion in traditional backstepping method. Compared with the traditional guidance and control separate design method, simulation results verify the practicalities and superiority of this integrated guidance and control (IGC) design algorithm whether the aerodynamic elevator is ideal or not.

articleTitle: New Structure of Spin Traveling Wave Pump on Magnetic Fluid
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: According to researching the spin traveling wave pump, the relationship of the characteristics of magnetic fluid and the press is investigated under the spin magnetic field by the theory method. The relationship of moving, magnetic field and press is investigated by the decoupled computation between the magnetic field and force. The method is scientificity and rationality by the testing. The distributing shape of magnetic fluid in the pump is affected by the adding magnetic field under the spin magnetic field when the magnetic fluid is filled in the pump. At the same time, the adding magnetic field is affected by magnetic particles of magnetic fluid. The magnetic fluid can be moved by the effect of the adding magnetic field in the pump. The flux of magnetic fluid increases with the magnetic field.

articleTitle: An Automatic Verification Assembly Line System for Electricity Meter
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The verification system could solve the problem of low efficiency existing in the traditional verification methods. The system is mainly composed of three components: server unit, client unit and control unit. The server unit is responsible for coordinating between clients. The client unit is applied for transferring data and updating the database. The control unit deploys the whole operation of assembly line. The system has achieved the functions of automatic verification, real-time monitoring, automatic information recording. The system improves the efficiency and accuracy of the verification of electricity meters.

articleTitle: The Ethical Framework Design of Battlefield Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the moral challenges of battlefield robots and the safety risks of robots being destroyed or controlled. This paper suggests that a moral module should be added to the combat or killing of battlefield robots, and a moral framework based on the law of war and the rules of war is designed. The moral framework mainly consists of three kinds of control procedures, namely entity judgment, personnel judgement and behavior judgment, which enhances the moral control of battlefield robots.

articleTitle: Level Set Evolution with SOM-Based Least Squares Twin SVM for Noisy Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper presents a novel hybrid framework derived from the least squares twin support vector machine (LSTSVM) and active contour model (ACM) for noisy image segmentation. It contains a two-stage process, where the concurrent self organizing maps (SOM) are firstly employed to approximate the image intensity distributions to establish the original training sets for the LSTSVM. The training sets are then updated by adding the global region intensity means during the curve evolution. Further, the discrimination functions of the LSTSVM are embedded into the energy function of the ACM to guide the curve movement. Besides, a variable regional coefficient is designed in the energy function to enhance the noise robustness. Experiment results demonstrate that our model holds higher segmentation accuracy and more noise robustness.

articleTitle: A GNSS Antenna Layout Evaluation Method for Hypersonic Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Due to hypersonic vehicle's high velocity, large attitude maneuver and wide envelope, unreasonable antenna layout will lead to bad performance of satellite navigation, such as the reduction of received GNSS satellite numbers or even non-positioning. In this paper, a GNSS antenna layout evaluation method for hypersonic vehicle is proposed to handle this problem. A hypersonic vehicle mission simulation and GNSS antenna layout evaluation environment based on STK/Matlab is established to validate the method, including the aircraft's typical trajectory and attitude data, navigation satellite constellation, and two different antenna layout models. The advantages and disadvantages of the two antenna layouts are analyzed. Based on the proposed method, the proper antenna layout which meets the flight safety and mission requirements is found out by calculating the receiving satellite numbers and PDOP of the GNSS receiver.

articleTitle: A Modified Power Allocation Algorithm Based on Convex Optimization and User Selection
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper studies power allocation schemes based on a precoding algorithm that maximizes signal to leakage plus noise ratio (SLNR) to optimize the sum capacity of MU-MIMO systems. To solve the problem that the result of an existing algorithm may contain negative power allocation factors at low SNRs, we proposed a sub-optimal iterative power allocation algorithm based on convex optimization with user scheduling. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme outperforms the existing ones at low SNRs, which can be used more widely. Moreover, better performance in terms of sum capacity can also be realized by the proposed algorithm compared with existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Design of Impedance Matching for Sound Signal Channel of PIND Testing Equipment
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Particle Impact Noise Detection (PIND) has been widely used in the detection of component redundancy due to its high efficiency and low cost. The traditional PIND device does not match the impedance of the sensor and the sound channel, so that the redundant signal will be attenuation and distortion in the transmission process, thus affecting its detection accuracy and sensitivity. Aiming at this problem, this paper presents a new scheme of impedance matching design, which uses the Smith chart method to match, and uses ADS simulation software to design impedance matching network. Finally, the matching experiment is used to verify the matching effect of impedance matching network.

articleTitle: Automated Joint Parameter Extractor for Robotics Virtual Simulation Using Virtual Reality Engine
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: We present a method of extracting joint parameters automatically from mesh models, which is a tough and indispensable procedure for virtual simulation of robots. A seeded region growing algorithm is used in our method to divide a mesh model into geometric feature recognized regions by only one traverse of triangular patches. To demonstrate the utility of our method, we develop an interactive plugin for the Unity3D platform with the algorithm and create a 3D virtual scene for robotic simulation. In contrast to previous techniques that require massive manual operation and calculation, our method is powerful, efficient, and widely-applicable.

articleTitle: Applicable to Launch Vehicle Data Integrated Design Method of Wireless Sensor Network Research
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Wireless sensor network technology is one of the computer science technologies developing rapidly in recent years. Based on advantages of flexibility in network topology technology, intelligent in data acquisition, low power consumption in network operation, wireless sensor network is used to obtain the carrier rocket test in the process of flight data has become the research emphasis in the field of aerospace test. This paper mainly introduces the rocket wireless sensor network topology, data synchronously in the network, integrated transmission encoding and redundancy, and provides technical support for engineering application.

articleTitle: Client Classification of Agricultural Products E-Commerce by RFM Model
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: It is the key link to maintain the relative competitive advantage to accurately classify the clients and take precise marketing strategy in the increasing competitive commercial market of Chinese agricultural products. The RFM model was introduced in this paper to construct the classification index of e-commerce clients of agricultural products and the client clustering was inspected in combination with the RFM analysis method of SPSS software and K-Means algorithm, it was found that the conclusion was the same to adopt these two methods: the e-commerce clients of agricultural products could be classified into 8 types and corresponding marketing strategy was proposed pertinent to clients of different types.

articleTitle: Enterprise Electronic Message Control Center Based on MSMQ and XMPP
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With the rapid increase in the number of enterprise information systems and the current situation of reduced business efficiency due to lack of unified message management mechanism. This paper puts forward a new idea of enterprise electronic Message Control center based on XMPP, and emphatically introduces three kinds of message push mechanism based on XMPP. In the end, the following work is prospected.

articleTitle: Annular Sector Hotspot Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Hotspot detection is widely applied in biology, environmental criminology and epidemiology. However, the traditional hotspot detection methods (e.g. round-shaped hotspot, rectangles hotspot, ring-shaped hotspot) do not take the existence of obstacles (such as rivers, hills) into consideration. Thus, the annular sector hotspot detection is proposed. Given a collection of geo-located activities, annular sector hotspot detection finds annular sector where concentration of activities inside it is much higher than outside. The likelihood ratio test is used to measure the intensity of the annular sector and the idea of grid is used to reduce the computation. Besides, the angles are cited to solve the problem of obstacles. The experiments are performed and the results show that the annular sector hotspot detection is reasonable and effective.

articleTitle: Progress of Software Vulnerability Identification and Automatic Test Cases Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With the development of computers and computer networks, software security is getting more and more attention. And in recent years, techniques of software vulnerability identification and automatic test cases generation get great progress. Based on advanced technologies, such as taint analysis and symbolic execution, there're lots of projects which play important roles in the practice of automatic test cases generation. This paper introduces the key technologies of them firstly. Then we introduce some relate competitions, current research programs and their corresponding tools which can generate test cases automatically.

articleTitle: Research and Design of GPS\BD Dual Mode Single-Channel IF Signal Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The classical high speed data acquisition platform based on FPGA and USB3.0 technology as the core, the IF signals of GPS L1 and BD B1 of the acquisition system can be received and converted into digital IF data. Designed the USB device of firmware program and host computer storage program, the High Speed acquisition, transmission and storage of IF data are achieved. The experimental results show that IF signal acquisition system of GPS\BD can be used in all location-based service(LBS) applications, IF data can be saved correctly and completely, and meet the requirements of data location.

articleTitle: A Color Selection Method for Crops Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The traditional crop classification uses artificial method all along, which has high cost and low efficiency. An automatic sorting method based on machine vision is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the non-uniformity correction of the CCD original signal is performed. Then the correction signal is converted from RGB color space to HSV space. The floodfill algorithm can obtain target pixel threshold value. The threshold segmentation data of the HSV color space is used to extract the target material. Finally all the pixels of the full image are divided to determine the location of the target material. The purpose of sorting the color and size of the material is achieved.

articleTitle: Design of Middleware Plug-in Architecture Based on Component Flexible Assembly Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A flexible assembly architecture for the middleware plug-in is presented. To support the automatic assembly and information interaction among test information resources, the middleware plug-in is divided into the object model implementation files and the plug-in adapter. The object model implementation files complete the information interaction of test resources. The plug-in adapter implements the information transfer of test resources and the dynamic assembly of the object model implementation files. In order to complete the interface design of the middleware plug-in, a set of middleware plug-in port mechanism is also proposed. Experimental results show that the architecture is able to save computer memory resources and improve the middleware information transmission efficiency.

articleTitle: Comment on "Impossible Differential Fault Analysis on the LED Lightweight Cryptosystem in the Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks"
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In January 2016, Li et al. introduced an impossible differential fault analysis on the LED cryptosystem. If one random nibble fault is injected into the preantepenultimate round of LED, 48 fault injections are required to recover the secret key. In this comment, we provide an improved scheme with theoretical analysis and experimental results. Under the same fault model, our analysis can reduce the key search space of LED to 27:92 on average with only ONE fault. The key extraction takes about 13.84 seconds on average.

articleTitle: Improving Crowd Counting with Multi-Task Multi-Scale Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Counting the number of person has received much attention in recent years. Most of the existing crowd counting methods adopted density map regression pipeline, which formulates the crowd counting problem to two fragmented part: density map regression and integration of the overall counting. To solve this problem, this paper presents a multi-task deep learning scheme to enhance the counting performance. More specifically, we firstly build a multi-scale deep convolutional neural network, based on combining the feature maps of conv layers with different filters, to solve the multi-scale problem in crowd counting. Secondly, we develop the multi-task structure that can simultaneously learn the density map and the global counting. Experiments on large scale crowd counting datasets, Shanghaitech and WorldExpo10, demonstrate that the proposed method achieves much reduction in counting error respectively.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Dynamical Measurement of RFID Tags Group Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Sensitivity is an important indicator for evaluating the performance of RFID tag. Firstly, this paper gives the definition of group tags sensitivity. Furthermore, the formula of the group tags sensitivity is deduced. Secondly, Semi-physical verification platform is used to measure the reading distance of the tags. Thirdly, the sensitivity for each tag in the tags group is tested. Finally, the group tags sensitivity is obtained and calibrated. The experimental results show that the formula accords with the actual result. Therefore, this work is very useful for dynamical measurement and calibration for RFID tags group sensitivity.

articleTitle: A Portable High-Precision Self-Calibration Time-Service System
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper mainly concerned with the design of a portable high-precision self-calibration time-service system, to solve the problem that the common time-service methods, which rely on the external time bases, cannot work when external signals are shielded. When the external frequency sources, such as satellites, networks and radios, are not available, this system can also provide us with a high-precision relative time-service, whose self-calibration time is less than 10min and daily time deviation is less than 10us. Different types of interface can also been offered for various users and devices.

articleTitle: Application of Adaptive Digital Processing Technology in Smart Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, according to the research on the smart antenna of adaptive signal processing technology, using LM-S algorithm to simulate the adaptive smart antenna array to verify its performance under harsh conditions to analyze its application in the actual situation; And through fusion with the transform domain filtering technology to solve the smart antenna useful signal and interference signal wave arrival direction is the same that the beamforming algorithm can not filter the interference signal problem.

articleTitle: Inertial Parameters On-Orbit Identification of Noncooperative Target in Postcapture
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In on-orbit servicing, when the noncooperative target is captured by the servicing spacecraft, the inertial parameters of the combined spacecraft will have a drift change, which could degrade the control performance even lead to tumbling. This paper proposes an on-orbit identification scheme for inertial parameters by utilizing space manipulator. First, according to conservation of momentum, the kinematic model of combined spacecraft which is combined by the servicing spacecraft and the target with manipulator is established. Next, the linearized equations of the inertial parameters to be identified are obtained. Then, the recursive least square (RLS) method based on fading memory is adopted as the parameter identification criterion and method. Finally, numerical co-simulation is performed on the Adams/Matlab platform. The simulation results show the effectiveness and validity of the identification scheme proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Failure Analysis and Remedial Measures of Infrared Lamp for Spacecraft Thermal Test
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The application of infrared simulation technology (infrared lamp) in vacuum thermal test of spacecraft has been studied in China since 1988.Up to now, the research of infrared lamp at home and abroad mainly focuses on infrared lamp simulation technology, infrared lamp product screening and quality control. However, due to the irreducible defects of infrared quartz tube itself, human error and other factors. Therefore, the failure of infrared lamp is inevitable in the process of test. At present, little research has been done on the effect of infrared lamp failure on the test and remedial measures. In this paper, the common infrared lamp array thermal analysis. The effects of infrared lamp failure in different regions on the uniformity and heating amplitude of the lamp array are studied. Secondly, the influence of infrared lamp failure on the test is analyzed. This paper studies how to take remedial measures for failure of infrared lamps in different regions under different working conditions. The surface heat flux uniformity of the spacecraft after the rescue is analyzed and the predicted results are given. Finally, systematic remedial measures and experimental attempts are formed through theoretical calculation.

articleTitle: XNAV/SINS Integrated Navigation for Deep Space Exploration with Pulsar Direction Error
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to decrease the influence of long observation period and the pulsar's direction error in X-ray pulsar navigation system (XNAV), an integrated navigation method is proposed with XNAV and the Straw-down inertial navigation system (SINS). The pulsar direction error is considered as the system bias and augmented to the system state equation. Then, the augmented state unscented Kalman filter (ASUKF) is designed for XNAV/SINS. The ASUKF filter algorithm is compared with the conventional UKF in Earth-Mars transfer orbit. Simulation results show the proposed ASUKF with XNAV/SINS performs better than the conventional UKF filtering method.

articleTitle: Adaptive Sliding Mode Backstepping Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of stability control of moving mass reentry vehicle, a backstepping sliding mode control law based on standard backstepping control theory is designed. Taking the perturbation of the aerodynamic parameters as the uncertain factors, the vehicle rolling angle and rolling angular velocity dual-loop sliding mode controllers are designed respectively. The virtual control of the angular velocity and the displacement command of sliding module are obtained. In the case which upper bound of the uncertainty is unknown, the adaptive method is used to design the approaching law parameters, in order to compensate for the uncertainty, and the stability of the closed-loop system is proved based on the Lyapunov function. The simulation results show that the method is effective and the tracking error is less than 0.4%.

articleTitle: A Remote Ultra-Low-Power Data Supervisory System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper describes a remote ultra-low-power data supervisory system based on Internet of things (IoT). It can serve as a terminal for remote meter reading or a data supervisory system for various digital instruments. The whole system is made up of two units, namely data acquisition and saving, data uploading and parameter configuration. The system has two excellent features, namely ultra-low-power and diversity of data acquisition. Actual test results show the system runs stability in an ultra-low-power.

articleTitle: Defect-Classification of Parts by BOW Algorithm Based on ZYNQ
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, the ZYNQ platform is chosen to realize the defect-classification of cup-shaped blank based on BOW algorithm. The embedded system provides a new way to implement the parts defect classification. The training samples are extracted and described by the SURF features, then the visual dictionary is generated by K-Means++ algorithm. The Support Vector Machine (SVM) is used to discriminate each class of the images to classify the defect of cup-shaped blanks. The experimental results show that the classification system is robust to the changes in angle and clarity, and the accuracy of classification in clear imaging is 89%.

articleTitle: Research on Taxi Travel Time Prediction Based on GBDT Machine Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Predicting taxi travel times throughout the city can help organize taxi teams and minimize waiting times for passengers and drivers, creating smart cities. In this paper, we propose to use the Gradient Lift Decision Tree (GBDT) learning model to predict the future travel time based on historical taxi trajectory information. Remembering past information is very important here because future taxi requests are related to information about past actions that took place. For example, someone needs to go to a shopping center and predict the time to better organize friends and follow-up schedules. We proposed a multidimensional feature method based on machine learning gradient enhancement decision tree model. This method uses the original data to construct multi-dimensional basic features and inputs it into the GBDT model to obtain high-level features and further improve the prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: A Study of Spacecraft Assembly Process System Framework and Key Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Aimed at the challenges faced by spacecraft general assembly process management under 3D design condition, this paper analyzes the application demands for the construction of process system based on 3D model, puts forward the overall framework of spacecraft general assembly process system, as well as gives ideas and methods for key technical problems in system implementation.

articleTitle: Application of PSO-RBF Neural Network in MBR Membrane Pollution Prediction
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to predict MBR fouling more accurately, based on the research of various forecasting models in the field of MBR, principal component analysis is used to determine the main factors influencing membrane fouling firstly, such as MLSS, operating pressure and temperature, and then the prediction model based on RBF neural network was established.Aiming at the existing problems of traditional radial basis function(RBF) neural network in MBR membrane pollution prediction, a new prediction model is proposed:Particle Swarm Optimization Based on RBF Neural Network.The global search ability of Particle Swarm Optimization(PSO) is used to optimize the three input parameters of RBF neural network and the optimized RBF network is applied to MBR membrane pollution prediction.The results show that PSO-RBF based fouling simulation simulator is better than pure RBF neural network prediction model in terms of convergence rate and prediction accuracy, which can predict MBR fouling better.

articleTitle: Defects Prediction of Aerospace Software Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Aerospace software is required to possess the quality of high reliability and high security, because the software quality directly determines the quality of the satellite. Software defects may result in the failure of the satellite mission. Defects prediction of the aerospace software will help discover and modify software defects in the early stage, which makes test resources allocate more reasonably, and thus it can improve the reliability and security of software and reduce the costs of software development. This paper presents a defect prediction method on aerospace software based on BP neural network, adopting the static attributes of software to predict the number of potential defects, and the method turns out to achieve good results.

articleTitle: Target Detection on Small Sample Specific Datasets
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In the actual situation, datasets with large amounts of data cannot directly obtain. Therefore, ensuring the accuracy and speed of the detection algorithm under small sample specific datasets is a key challenge for building target detection. This paper improved the algorithm based on Yolov2, expand small sample data sets to achieve accurate detection of targets.

articleTitle: A Survey of Flying Ad-Hoc Networks: Characteristics and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper mainly concerned with a survey of Flying Ad-Hoc networks (FANETs). FANET, which defined as a new Ad-Hoc network family between Unmanned Air Vehicles (UAVs), has attracted great interests between industry and academy in the past few years. Rather than the traditional mobile Ad-Hoc networks (MANETs) and vehicular Ad-Hoc networks (VANETs), the nodes in FANET have some new features, such as Line-of-sight (LoS) dominated radio propagation channel, higher mobility, and more rapidly changing network topology. Due to these specific characteristics, the classic communication methods on fixed networks and slowly moving networks may not be feasible. The challenges in FANET design characteristics and communication protocols have been proposed. Moreover, the open research issues have been also discussed.

articleTitle: Enabling Relay Selection in Cooperative Networks by Supervised Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In fifth generation (5G) networks, cooperative transmission assisted by relays is believed to be an essential element, which significantly improves the system reliability and enhances the network design flexibility. To coordinate multiple relays in cooperative networks and utilize them in an efficient manner, relay selection is required. In this paper, we enable a generic relay selection scenario by supervised machine learning techniques and propose a prototype framework for further investigation. The prototype framework is constructed by a relatively simple artificial neural network consisting of only one hidden layer and the number of neurons in the hidden layer is equal to the number of inputs/outputs. Numerical results show that any relay selection criteria that conform to a certain form can be implemented by such a simple prototype framework, which can reduce the required system complexity for performing complicated processing of relay selection by conventional algorithms. Furthermore, we also point out a number of potential research directions that are worth investigating as future work.

articleTitle: Vector-Sensor Array DOA Estimation Based on Spatial Time-Frequency Distribution
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation is one of the classical problems in the realm of array signal processing, and its applications include such areas as navigation, tracking, communication. Conventional approaches for DOA estimation make utilize of an array of pressure sensors, which have been distributed at different locations. This paper deals with measurements obtained by an acoustical vector-sensor array and develops a new approach which exploits the spatial time-frequency information of the underlying vector-sensor array signal to achieve better DOA estimation performance even in a noisy and coherent environment. Numerical simulations are conducted to quantify the performance and evaluate the theoretical results developed in this paper. Concretely speaking, Simulation results show that under several frequently encountered scenarios, such as a single source and two closely spaced coherent sources, our proposed approach can achieve significant performance improvements. Furthermore, the superior root mean square error (RMSE) performance of our proposed algorithm against noise is demonstrated via Monte-Carlo numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Path Planning Based on Improved Intelligent Water Drop Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) has been a research focus in recent years and the path planner is a key element of the UAV autonomous control module. In this paper, a novel UAV path planning method based on intelligent water drop algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the mathematical model of the UAV path planning problem is presented. Secondly, an improved intelligent water drop algorithm is proposed to solve the UAV path planning model. In the proposed algorithm, a novel path construction mechanism is proposed and an adaptive global soli update mechanism is developed. The proposed algorithm can overcome some shortages of the original ITD algorithm, such as slow search speed, easily falling into local minima, and so on. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed planner outperforms the original ITD planner in a statistical manner.

articleTitle: Research on Internal Temperature of Transformer Internal Temperature Based on Optical Fiber Sensing Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Transformer is an important link of power system, and its operation state directly affects the security and stability of power system operation. With the continuous development of the national economy and the continuous improvement of the people's needs, the power grid load has been continuously improved, and the capacity of the transformer has been continuously expanded, and the accident rate has increased accordingly. According to related statistics, more than 66 kv transformer of the world's average accident rate over 0.89%, especially in recent years, the transformer for winding overtemperature operation, result in transformer winding insulation aging and breakdown, accident of burning large ratio (according to the statistics, about 80% of the accident rate above). For oil-immersed power transformer, the time depends on the service life of solid insulating materials (fiber paper), prompting insulation materials is the main factor of aging temperature, moisture and oxygen, heat effect of transformer insulation aging is the decisive factor, therefore the transformer internal main parts (winding and iron core, the place such as insulating oil) temperature decides the service life of the transformer temperature due to the electric power equipment testing environment with high voltage and strong electromagnetic interference, and space is narrow, the traditional method cannot directly on the power equipment temperature state of online measurement, and a new temperature measuring system based on semiconductor optical fiber sensing technology has small volume, good insulation, good resistance to electromagnetic interference, temperature measurement consistency, can be directly installed on the transformer and other power equipment inside, can accurate and fast reflect the change of the internal temperature of main components of power transformer, the transformer winding and iron core, the place such as insulating oil temperature real-time online measurement.

articleTitle: Design of River Water Quality Assessment and Prediction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Due to the rapid population growth and rapid economic development, water environmental protection pressures are increasing day by day. This paper focuses on the pollution of water quality in river basins, establishing a water quality assessment model to analyze the level of water quality, and makes a objective further prediction of the development trend of factors of water quality. In this paper, the mutation factor of genetic algorithm is introduced into the PSO algorithm, and the Least Squares Support Vector Machine (LS-SVM) based on adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to optimize the hyper-parameter, establishing a water quality classification assessment model. The fuzzy information granulation method is combined with the Least Square Support Regression (LS-SVR) in this paper to establish a water quality time series model, which can predict the trend of changes in water quality data in the next three days. Compared with the traditional BP neural network, the assessment model and the prediction model algorithm are faster in training speed and higher in accuracy with the help of the theoretical analysis and experimental data.

articleTitle: Research and Discussion on High Precision Image Location Technology in Large Scale Surveying and Mapping Mission
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The accuracy of image positioning is the key to large scale surveying and mapping, and its main factors include the positioning and orbit determination, attitude stability, the stability of the azimuth element in the surveying camera, and the high precision ground calibration technology. This paper mainly analyzes and estimates the influential factors and indexes of very high precision image positioning, and puts forward the corresponding guarantee measures. At the same time, the relevant key technologies are explored to provide technical support and reference for the implementation of large scale surveying and mapping satellite engineering.

articleTitle: The Design and Verify of Multi-Module Spacecraft Joint Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The power supply system of muti-module spacecraft in domestic and foreign is investigated, and the power supply characteristics and typical power supply solutions of muti-module spacecraft is analyzed in this paper. Taking a deep space lunar probe as an example, a design scheme of combined power supply between multiple module is presented in this paper.The simulation model is established, and the different working modes of the combined power supply are simulated and verified. The comparison between the experimental data and the simulation results verifies the feasibility of the design. As the same time, this paper also provides an important theoretical basis for further improving the design capability of multi-module spacecraft power system and developing a more reliable spacecraft power supply system. It can be used to guide the design of multi-module spacecraft power system in the future.

articleTitle: Automated Order Tracking Sampling Method and an FHT Order Optimization Algorithm Based DE for Health Monitoring of Direct-Drive Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Nowadays, the bearing vibration signal is commonly used in the fault detection of direct-drive wind turbines. The main shaft speed is inconstant which results in the bearing vibration signal non-stationary in time domain. Sampling the signal with a constant time increment and then spectrum analyzing will cause the spectrum smearing problem. Therefore, the paper proposes an automated order tracking method which achieves sampling signals with a constant angle increment instead of a constant time increment in hardware platform. The stationary signal in angle domain is acquired to solve the spectrum smearing problem. In spectral analysis of vibration signals obtained, this paper uses the envelope analysis method based on Fractional Hilbert Transform (FHT) and proposes a faster and more accurate method based on differential evolution (DE) in order to optimize the order of FHT.

articleTitle: Modified Adaptive Differential Evolution Algorithm for Test Scheduling of Multi-Core SOC Based on DVS and MVI
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: As a popular kind of system chip, multi-core SOC based on DVS and MVI has the advantages of low power consumption and high performance. However, the test technology is still in the exploration stage, being the first problem restricting the development of multi-core SOC. In this paper, a new modified differential evolution algorithm (JADE-MaS) is applied to system-level test optimization. JADE-MaS proposes a multiangle searching strategy and obtains good effect on enhancing population diversity. The mathematical model of TAM resource division and test scheduling include four decision variables: the test bus width, the location of IP cores, the start and end times of the test. We encode the first two variables as population individuals and use JADE-MaS to seek the optimal individual, then use a priority scheduling mechanism based on heuristic algorithm to distribute the test tasks to evaluate the individual fitness. The remaining variables can also be solved in this process. After being decoded, the individual with the shortest test time is the solution of system-level test scheduling problem. Series of experiments on ITC'02 SOC benchmarks show that JADE-MaS has searched the better scheme comparing with the GA and the PSO algorithm and effectively shortens the system-level test time.

articleTitle: Sub-Pixel Image Registration Based on Extended Alignment Metric
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper proposes a sub-pixel registration method based on analytic method to meet the requirement of high accuracy and time efficiency in image processing. Image registration is a coarse-to-fine process, thus in this paper, integer pixel match is firstly obtained via maximizing the alignment metric, and the sub-pixel image registration is a single step to solve a optimization problem by analytic method. A mathematical model of estimating image similarity is established with the precise sub-pixel coordinates unknown and a polynomial is constructed to express the similarity between two images. Registration position is the right point the polynomial gets a peak value. Experimental results show the proposed algorithm reduces the computation time and gets a high accuracy when experiments are conducted on image databases and self-collected videos and pictures.

articleTitle: Multi-Channel Polarization Image Registration Using Improved SURF Based on Phase Congruency and Log-Gabor Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulties of feature detection and feature matching caused by the geometric distortion and gray-scale radiation difference between dual-channel polarization images, this paper proposes an image registration method based on improved SURF with phase congruency and Log-Gabor filter. Firstly, the phase congruency model is introduced to eliminate the difference in grayscale or contrast between images. The SURF feature points are detected by edge images, which have more stable structural features. Then, the Log-Gabor filter is used to structure a robust local feature description. Finally, the proposed method uses the mutual information measure and RANSAC to perform feature point matching and refinement, and the multi-channel polarization images are accurately matched by the geometrical transformation and bilinear interpolation. The experiment results indicated that the proposed method can effectively improve the matching rate of feature point pairs compared with the classical SURF method. Especially for image registration with different polarization directions and different bands, the proposed method had more accuracy, which can reach within 1 pixel.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Orbit Hybrid Satellite Network Routing Algorithm Based on Detection and Self-Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With the rapid development of commercial space program, the constellations of low-orbit satellites continue to emerge. The use of satellite networks and terrestrial networks to construct a space-ground integrated network and provide users with seamlessly connected communication services has become a trend in the future. Due to the relative motion characteristics of satellites, existing routing technologies such as routing algorithms based on rule-based network topology can no longer meet the requirements for routing calculation in such a dynamic network topology. Based on the analysis of the routing strategies of existing typical satellite networks and the characteristics of satellite operation, this paper illustrates a multi-orbit hybrid satellite network routing algorithm based on detection and self-learning. The algorithm has a simple control process with high reliability. The simulation results show that the protocol has good network performance in terms of effective data transmission rate and data routing hops, and can support the design of routing protocols for multi-orbit mixed satellite networks.

articleTitle: Analysis and Comparison of 3D Reconstruction Volume Rendering Algorithms for Robot-Assisted Surgery
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Volume rendering technology is an important part of scientific computing visualization, and has great research value and a wide range of application prospects. This paper studies two typical volume rendering algorithms, which are volume rendering in order of image space, including Composite Volume Rendering (CVR), Maximum Intensity Projection (MIP) and Isosurface Volume Rendering (IVR), and volume rendering in order of object space, including Shear Warp algorithm (SW). These algorithms are implemented by 3D reconstruction of the patient CT tomographic images by VC++ and VTK. At the same time, this paper analyzes and compares the respective performances of these algorithms. Through these evaluations, more appropriate volume rendering algorithms applied in robot-assisted surgery can be selected.

articleTitle: Landslide and Debris Flow Hazard Risk Analysis and Assessment in Yunnan Province
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Landslides and debris flow often cause serious economic losses and casualties. In recent years, the occurrence of geological hazards such as landslides and debris flow in Yunnan has been increasing. According to various factors causing landslide and debris flow in Yunnan Province, this paper selected rainfall, slope, fault, earthquake, lithology, and vegetation coverage as assessment factors. Combined AHP and GIS analysis method, single-factor risk assessment and comprehensive assessment method are used to evaluate the risk of landslide debris flow in Yunnan Province. The results show that nearly 30% of Yunnan has a high incidence area of landslide and debris flow. Moreover, the spatial distribution of landslide and debris flow has the general characteristics of "west less than east, north less than south, and less middle."

articleTitle: Bursty Events Detection Approach on Chinese Microblog Based on Splay Tree Optimization
