publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: As a new media, Microblog plays an important role in people's daily life. People can gain, publish and share information in time, and interact with other users. With the characteristics of small text, spreading fast and great impact, an increasing number of scholars choose Microblog as their research object. Since Microblog generates a huge amount of data, bursty events detection seems to be very important. An algorithm based on the splay tree optimization is proposed so as to reduce the burst words clustering by recording the existing results. This paper adopts the method of trade space for time to optimize the algorithm, which changes the original complexity of the burst words clustering algorithm O(SN<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) into O(SN<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> log(N). The worst space complexity becomes O(N<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), however, it turns to be O(LN) by merely recording the effective results combined with the actual situation. Value L is related to the scale of cluster in the clustering result.

articleTitle: The Transformer Winding Deformation Based on Finite Element Method and Regular Limit Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The frequency response method is characterized by its stability, efficiency, lossless, economy and simplicity so it is widely used in transformer testing project. The frequency response method mainly uses the comparison of the amplitude spectrum of transfer function to determine the winding state. Subsequently, correlation coefficient and mean variance value concept were introduced successively. Frequency response analysis method with simple light test equipment, test sensitivity, visual experimental spectrum analysis, the data quantity analysis has the advantages such as comparability, so this article use the frequency response method to test the winding deformation. After the detection of transformer winding deformation by frequency response method, it is necessary to identify the deformation type, in this paper, the frequency response characteristic curve is quantized by using the limit learning machine, and the transformer winding deformation category is judged based on the unified standard. Thus minimizing the human error of the staff. Firstly, the capacitance and inductance parameters of the equivalent circuit are calculated by finite element method. Then the transformer winding deformation is detected by frequency response method. Finally, the identification of deformation type is completed by the ultimate learning machine.

articleTitle: Bayesian Classifier Suitable for Imbalanced Data
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Traditional Bayesian classifier can make good performance at dealing with well-balanced data. However, the data is usually imbalanced in real world. So it may lead to the decline of traditional Bayesian classifier's capability at solving the problem of class imbalanced data classification. This paper presented a method based on continuous attribute distribution characteristic to set the evaluation function and search the optimal window width, by this means, a Bayesian classifier based on continuous attribute can be constructed. The method utilized the distance-based attribute selection method to improve the efficiency. The local optimization of prior probability can be obtained by calculating overlapping area. And we take advantage of the joint estimation to obtain the implicit information between more attributes. The intermediate parameter can be locally optimized by the intelligent algorithm. Experiments show that the proposed method improves the accuracy of the unbalanced data classification effectively.

articleTitle: Time Series Classification Based on Dictionary Learning and Sparse Representation
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The high-dimensionality, shifting and distortion are considered as the main difficulties in time series classification. In this paper, a novel technique based on dictionary learning and sparse representation is developed to conquer these difficulties. Dictionary, which is a set of series or segments, is able to reconstruct signals sparsely. We use dictionary learning to reconstruct time series and introduce k-nearest neighbor classifier based on dynamic time warping to improve the quality of approximation of dictionary. Sparse coding is used to reconstruct an unseen series. The class label of an unseen series is determined by the reconstructive error. Extensive experiments were conducted to test the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. Experimental results show that the proposed technique achieved significant improvements compared with some existing algorithms.

articleTitle: A Method of Software System Security Verification and Evaluation Based on Extension of AADL Model
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In the complex hardware and software hybrid system, the rapid increase of the software scale and the system complexity bring the important challenge to the software security modeling. There are still many functional or semantic problems for traditional modeling language and modeling method, when they are used into the security modeling. Therefore, based on the Architecture Analysis and Design Language (AADL), this paper proposes the AADL error model and extracted the timing fault tree. After comprehensive analysis by using the common factor failure analysis and the hardware and software failure analysis, we can obtain the generation mechanism of danger. By establishing the AADL multi-view security model of the software system, and converting it into the Timed Abstract State Machine (TASM) and the Markov model, this paper forms a method of the security verification and evaluation based on extended AADL model. Finally, we confirm the effectiveness of the proposed method by performing security analysis for an instance.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the Internal Source Harmonic Control and Power-Saving Efficiency in Agriculture Logistics Zones
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The harmonic generated by the internal system and device of the agriculture logistics zone is abbreviated as the internal source harmonic of power quality in this paper. The internal source harmonic usually triggers the mis-operation of devices in the automatic warehouse logistics in the zone, which may increase of damage rate of logistics products and reduce the life span of logistics device severely. It has already reached a consensus that the internal source harmonic control will realize the safe and steady operation of logistics device and effective utilization of power, and further reduce the electric quantity of the zone and relevant costs. Due to the unbalanced production rhythm of agricultural products, and impact of composite factors like the market season and social environment, the production and operation in the zone features dynamics and instability, and it is also difficult to calculate the economic benefit like the power-saving quantity after the harmonic control. At present, there has not been a general quantitative method of power-saving efficiency in the industry, which has restrained the promotion of harmonic control technology to a certain extent. On this basis, this paper attempts to put forward a more systematic harmonic control strategic in the context of the harmonic generated by the internal device of the agriculture logistics zone by integrating effective expert knowledge and experience, and calculate the economic benefit after the harmonic control of the logistics zone rapidly and accurately by combining the power-saving factors and harmonic data of all major nodes in the zone through practical engineering cases, thus to verify the effectiveness of the evaluation on the power-saving efficiency proposed in this paper

articleTitle: A Quality Evaluation Method for the Construction of National Laboratories
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A quality evaluation method for the construction of national laboratories is proposed. The composition and main research fields of U.S. national laboratory are given. The orientation, development objective, main tasks and management model of U.S. national laboratory are presented. The quality evaluation method is proposed based on the analysis of the basic characteristics of the U.S. GPL National Laboratory, which is composed of the national strategy orientation, comprehensive and integrated scale, interdisciplinary integration, forward-looking risk and breakthrough, system and mechanism innovation. The quality evaluation factors for the construction of Chinese national laboratories is presented. The five critical factors for the development of Chinese national laboratory is proposed, which is the suggestions to the significance and establishment approach of national laboratory.

articleTitle: Survey of Matrix Completion Models
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In recent years, matrix completion (MC), derived from CS, has increasingly become a hot research topic in the field of machine learning. Many researchers have done a large number of fruitful studies on MC. In order to better grasp the development process of MC, the existing matrix completion models (MCMs) are reviewed. First, the process of the evolution from CS to MC is described, illustrating that the development of CS theory has laid the foundation for the formation of MC theory. Second, the existing MCMs are divided into four categories from the perspective of the relaxation of nonconvex and nonsmooth rank function, aiming to provide reasonable solutions for specific matrix completion applications. Finally, the existing problems in current matrix completion technology are pointed out and analyzed, meanwhile possible solutions for these problems are proposed, and the future work is discussed.

articleTitle: Spare Sensing Matrix Construction for Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Compressed sensing (CS) enables new sampling theories to provide revolutionary approaches for data acquisition. Unlike traditional methods, it allows a parse or compressible signal to be reconstructed from much fewer measurements. To guarantee exact recovery from compressed measurements, a specific matrix satisfying the Restricted Isometry Property (RIP) is necessary in the sensing procedure. In this paper, we first propose matrix, which only contains 0 and 1. Then we propose spare sensing matrix (SSM) based on the binary matrix. Additionally, we propose a RIP testing method to prove that SSM satisfy RIP. However, the size of SSM is constrained by sum of elements in every column and the maximum inner product of any two different column of binary matrix. To solve the problem, we propose two methods to increase the number of column and the number of row for SSM correspondingly. Simulation experiments show that SSM performs almost the same as Gauss sensing matrix. While the performance of improved SSM is much better than SSM and Gauss sensing matrix.

articleTitle: LSTM Network for Carrier Module Detection Data Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: At any time the popularity of the Internet, the city's smart grid has been developing rapidly. At the same time, the number of smart meters has increased year by year. The effective mining of the power module carrier module data has also been upgraded to a new level. However, due to the fact that the existing carrier module data analysis scheme is not mature enough, a complete set of data analysis schemes for carrier module is urgently needed in the market. Through the most advanced detection technology and data analysis method, we can realize the data mining of carrier module and improve the use value of data. In the past, traditional statistical learning methods are used, such as naive Bayes and support vector machines, but with the progress of the times, these technologies can not meet the needs of people. Different from the past, this paper proposes a deep learning network based algorithm for data mining of carrier module detection. The carrier module detection data is modeled by LSTM deep neural network to automatically identify the different noise environment, and then the carrier module is dynamically adjusted according to the recognition results. Experiments show that the model has very good results. In addition, the technology solution will not affect the existing business processes. As far as we know, this is the first time to apply the deep learning method to the analysis of the carrier module detection data, which has a great inspiration for the future power system data processing.

articleTitle: The Current Sensor Design Based on Full-Symmetric and Non-Magnetic Rogowski Coil
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Current sensor plays an irreplaceable role in the measurement and protection of power system. In this paper, we designed a new current sensor based on full-symmetric and non-magnetic Rogowski coil, which can be used under complex electromagnetic environment because of its excellent uniformity and great anti-interference property. By simulating the equivalent circuit and measuring the induced electromotive force, experiments have been designed to test 3 different wiring methods of Rogowski coil. The best wiring method have been selected depending on the relative error between experimental data and the standard value, which is obtained by calculating the transfer formula in not only time domain but also frequency domain. Meanwhile, the conditioning circuit has been designed according to the circumstances. The experiment shows that wiring methods of full-symmetric and non-magnetic Rogowski coil have certain effect on the measurement accuracy, and taking frequency domain features into account when calculating the standard value helps to improve the performance of the current sensor.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Management and Control System of Flexible Transmission Assembly Line
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The system realizes the setting of assembly plan, the establishment of assembly process files, the feedback of equipment status and the reconfiguration of assembly tasks. It uses industrial Ethernet for data exchange to achieve the integration of management and control through the OPC interface. All the equipments based on logic control of PLC are fully automated. The client running on IPC is programmed with C#. All the device workstations are configured RFID. On the one hand, assembly data can be uploaded to management system together with the code number of the transmission read by RFID to trace the information of assembly process. On the other hand, assembly process parameters generated automatically by management system can be transferred to the equipments to achieve the reconfiguration of technological process.

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of Anterior Myocardial Infarction Using Combined Linear and Nonlinear Features of ECG Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Timely recognition of changes occurring in the electrocardiogram(ECG) leads is important to identify anteroseptal myocardial infraction (ASMI). Many existing detection methods extract linear feature from ECG data. However, hidden information in the ECG signals can be extracted from nonlinear features. A combination of linear and nonlinear features of ECG is proposed to improve the classification of ASMI and normal subjects. Linear features related to ECG morphology contain S and T wave amplitude, negative area of S wave and ST segment derivate. Moreover, discrete wavelet transformation(DWT) is used in ECG data, and then three types of nonlinear features are obtained from the DWT coefficients, containing approximate entropy, Shannon entropy and wavelet entropy. PTB database is used to evaluate the performance of proposed method by SVM classifier. We only use lead V2 ECG signal. Our proposed method yielded classification results of 99.76% accuracy. The sensitivity for normal is 99.83% and for ASMI is 99.71%. Our proposed method can be used for locating the ASMI by studying one lead and there is no need for analyzing other leads. Thus, our proposed algorithm can assist the physicians to locate ASMI accurately.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Spacecraft On-Board Software Maintenance Based on TMR System
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With the development of China's space industry, embedded software has been widely used in spacecraft. In view of the high reliability and maintainability requirements of space missions, we need to focus on the key problem of on-board maintenance of embedded software. To satisfy the on-board maintenance requirement of real time embedded system, this paper proposes an implementation method of on-board software maintenance in triple modular redundancy system. This method adds three-machine communication management module to the traditional on-board maintenance software, and uses three-machine communication interface to transmit telecommand data to realize the on-board maintenance function of the backup machine. After testing and verifying, this method can complete software maintenance for the backup machine while ensuring that the system works without interruption and meets the requirements of continuous work.

articleTitle: Research on Coating Thickness Measurement with Eddy Current
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The thickness of the surface coating has a great influence on their performance in the application of metal materials. Accurate measurement of the coating thickness is of great significance. In this paper, based on the eddy current thickness measurement principle, the information of coating thickness can be converted into the parallel resonance impedance as a reaction of the information using the digital conversion function of LDC1000 chip. The reasonable probe structure is designed, and the data processing methods such as mean filtering, weighted filtering and zero point calibration are adopted to ensure the accuracy and stability of the measurement. In the comparison of the RP-Thickness curve obtained from the fitting of the experimental data by the least weighted square method and the simulation curve of RP and thickness, the results show that the two curve are basically consistent, which proves the reliability of the proposed scheme. Compared with the previous methods, this scheme can reduce the cost of measurement and guarantee the accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Point Cloud Model Reconstruction Method Based on Multi-Kinects
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: 3D reconstruction technology has always been a challenging research topic in the field of computer vision, a new 3D reconstruction system based on the new generation Kinect V2 is proposed in this paper, use two Kinects to collect object images from different views on the same horizontal line, through the calibration, denoising, registration and image mosaic, the 3D point cloud model of the object is obtained, the experimental results show that the method has better practicability and feasibility than kinectv1, which can be widely used in 3D reconstruction.

articleTitle: Forced Access Control Model in Distributed Platform Based on Operation Sets
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: By improve the union model of BLP and Biba and real-time comparison strategy, let it more flexible to read and write, to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of data. Adjustments has done to adap well to distributed storage characteristics ,by feasibility studies, the model can effectively protect confidentiality and integrity of data in distributed platform.

articleTitle: A Method of Developing Spacecraft Software Components Based on Non-Object Oriented Language
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to further improve the spacecraft on-board software reuse scale and to solve the problem of the on-board software inefficient development, this paper analyzed and researched the characteristics of spacecraft software and software component technology, after that, it made a definition of the on-board software component, proposed an on-board software component mod-el, which is based on non-object oriented language and suitable of spacecraft. The on-board software components are independent, integrate, assemble and functional. Besides, the method for on-board software component design, develop and implement is described, and can be the guide of on-board software component developed based on non-object oriented language. Then, some examples are given, in which the software systems are developed according the method proposed in this paper. The simulation results show that Spacecraft software component Develop methods are effective for advancing the spacecraft software develop efficiency?

articleTitle: Intelligent Verification System Based on RFID Smart Electricity Meter
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With the centralization of measurement assets, standardized management and the launch of a new generation of RFID smart electricity meters, the traditional methods of man-machine verification of electricity meters have been unable to meet the demand. In order to realize the verification of RFID smart electricity meters and improve the verification efficiency and the informatization management level, and liberate the labor force of inspectors, on the basis of existing smart meter detection system, this paper designed a new intelligent detection system based on RFID smart electricity meter. RFID technology is applied to the smart electricity meter verification system. The system can meet fully automatic verification of RFID smart meters, and effectively track and record the verification data of RFID smart meters, which greatly improves the verification efficiency.

articleTitle: A New Index for Evolutionary Algorithms to Measure the Noise Level in Noisy Environments
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In noisy situation, multiobjective evolutionary algorithm will lose the ability to search optimum results. The reason of this phenomenon is evolutionary algorithma shows the disorder of domination relationship to population individual. Focusing to this problem, lots of research have been made. One of them is the method resampling. The method is indeed improving the bad domination relationship of population individual in the noisy situation. However, there is no clear data parameter to show the degree of improving domination relationship when using the resampling method. So this paper presents a new index as a proof that with the increase of the number of resampling times, the proportion of correct judgment in the noisy situation of multiobjective evolutionary algorithm's domination relationship is also increasing.

articleTitle: Online Consumer Review Intentions: A Comparative Study of Chinese and American
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The contents of online consumer reviews are important for e-commerce platform enterprises and online consumers, while most of online customers are reluctant to contribute their consumption experiences. The aim of this paper is to formulate a novel research model to explain and compare different cultural consumer review intentions. Based on social exchange theory, the proposed model is to identify benefit and cost factors which have an important influence upon contributing review intentions for users. The model is then validated through the online survey of the users on the Amazon.com and Amazon.cn. The results show that the reciprocity, reputation and review cost play a significant impact on consumer review intentions both in China and the USA, while economic rewards appear to play little impact on consumer review intentions, and the cultural difference between China and the USA plays insignificantly. Related implications for e-commerce platform enterprises and future research work are discussed.

articleTitle: Public Key Encryption with Wildcards Keyword Search
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A new searchable encryption scheme that support queries for keywords containing wildcards is proposed. The scheme reveals trivial information about keywords. In the scheme the number of charactors included in the trapdoor keywords does not have to be the same with the searched keywords. Consequently it is more practical and flexible than the existing scheme.The scheme can be proven to be IND-CPA Security in the Selective-Set Model.

articleTitle: A New Method for Fast Path Planning of Underwater Vehicle in the Shallow Sea Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In view of the problem that the optimal solution quality of classic path planning methods for underwater vehicle is not good enough to guarantee that there has the best path in the complex environment of shallow coastal waters. A new fast path planning method for complex shallow sea environment is proposed in this paper. The method uses inner and extra loop search strategies to ensure that the planned path is globally optimal. The simulation results show that the new method can find an optimal path rapidly between the starting point and the destination point under the premise of avoiding reefs and other risks. Considering the voyage constraints, energy constraints, exposure risks and special shallow sea working environment comprehensively, the new method is more suitable for the fast path planning of underwater vehicle than the traditional A* algorithm.

articleTitle: The Development and Application of CNC Lathe for Electrical Maintenance of Teaching Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The CNC integrated experiment platform (Teaching Machine) can simulate operations of actual CNC lathes, such as manual operation, programming, automatic tool changing, and automatic machining. The lathe can be operated like a real CNC lathe by students without worrying about the safety problems; and setting failure points by the PLC of system settings use ladder. CNC experiment teachers can design failure points of different difficulties according to students' level, from shallow to deep, which gives full play to CNC experiment teachers' subjective initiative in teaching. After being proficient in operating, students will make progress on the basis of programming and operating, and be able to carry out preliminary maintenance work on CNC machine so as to achieve the aim of solving the urgent need of comprehensive technical staff with programming and maintaining ability in the enterprises.

articleTitle: Speech Emotion Recognition Based on Kernel Principal Component Analysis and Optimized Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Speech emotion recognition is a hot topic nowadays. In order to improve recognition rates, we propose a new solution based on kernel principal component analysis (KPCA) and optimized SVM. KPCA reduces features dimension, while the gravity search algorithm (GSA) is used to optimize support vector machine (SVM) classification performances. We show that KPCA with Gaussian kernel function applied to the Berlin emotional speech database, KPCA outperforms the classical principal. On the other hand, we present experimental results showing that the GSA-SVM model achieves higher recognition rates and runs faster than two classical optimized SVM namely the SVM-particle swarm and the SVM-genetic algorithm. Combined together the KPCA-GSA/SVM achieves good recognition rates.

articleTitle: A Poisson-Disk Sampling Based Strategy for Node Placement in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is a popular research field in recent years. This paper focuses on node placement of WSN applications, as monitoring physical value (e.g., temperature) or tracking paths of moving objects in surrounding environment. Inspired by anti-aliasing theory in sampling field, we present a Poisson-disk Sampling (PDS) based strategy for WSN node placement. With the theory of sampling, we study the spectral properties of node distribution, in order to reduce the deviation of data collection result. Simulation results show that PDS outperforms other placement methods, such as regular and random strategies, in terms of monitoring surrounding environment. In addition, we apply the PDS-based strategy to various WSN applications and design a simple energy-saving pattern with coverage and connectivity preserved.

articleTitle: Design of 3D Computer Room Monitoring System for FM Transmitter Based on WebGL
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: For the traditional two-dimensional display room is not intuitive, there is an interactive experience weak, low efficiency analysis, the information level is not rich enough, easy to cause room management security risks. And the existing 3D room monitoring system need to install plug-ins and other issues, a monitoring system of FM transmitting 3D computer room based on WebGL is proposed. The system adopts the B/S structure and the use of the WebGL-based Three.js 3D engine to achieve the FM transmitter 3D room overall construction, real-time monitoring and user interaction functions, the operation of all completed in the browser side. With no need to install plug-ins, cross-browser and cross-platform compatibility and the use of more convenient advantages.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of APS Test System for High-Speed and Large Array APS Device Based on Camera-Link
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper analyzed the working principle and interface character of the APS image sensor, and designed an APS test system for high-speed and large array APS device based on the Camera-Link interface. The system was made up of several subsystems as lighting control, pattern generator, image data gather and analyze. By using FPGA device, this paper designed the interface of APS to Camera-Link and solved the problem of mass data transfer during APS-testing. By analyzing the output of the APS pixels under different exposure time, this system could test the key specifications of APS device like saturation exposure time, saturation output curve and bad pixels.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Incipient Fault Detection in Analog Circuits
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A novel approach for incipient fault detection in analog circuit is presented in this paper. A testing stimulus generating method has been proposed, based on statistical distribution characteristic of response signal for both normal state and fault state, using compactness index to indicate the deviation between the incipient fault state and normal state, so the test stimulus, which can furthest stimulate the weak fault features of incipient faults can be selected according to the compactness measuring algorithm. After using wavelet transform to the response signal, for fault feature extraction, one-class classifier Support Vector Data Description (SVDD) has been used as fault classifier for fault detection. The proposed method has been verified by experiment results, and proved to be effective especially on the incipient fault of analog circuits.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Paper Composition Based on Improved Multi-Population Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Concerning intelligent paper composition, the article puts forward an improved genetic algorithm (GA) based on the multi-population division. According to the ideas of population division, the genes of individuals in the population which control the same characters are further divided into the same sub population so that they can be performed by the genetic operators. In order to avoid the local optimum, the optimal solution of each sub population is selected to be recombined global optimum. Compared with the simple genetic algorithm (SGA), this algorithm significantly reduces the search space of the problem solution and accelerates convergence speed. Finally, the algorithm is verified in the problem of intelligent paper composition and the results indicate that the algorithm has obviously improved the quality of the intelligent paper composition compared with the SGA.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking Strategy of Quadrotor with Output Delay
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A nonlinear output-feedback control strategy is devised using delayed-output observer for an underactuated quadrotor to track a given reference trajectory. The presented strategy consists of a delayed-output observer. A two-step observation algorithm is used to reconstruct the system conditions to compose the presented observer. By utilizing the presented strategy, the problem of time-delay is solved. The dynamic model of the quadrotor is presented firstly. To guarantee that the observation of the specific delay factors in the system is exponential convergent to zero under the given conditions. The advantages of the presented strategy are its practicability and extensive applications. Numerical results are presented for a practical tracking case under arbitrarily large initial and desired conditions.

articleTitle: Analysis Technique of Remote Condition Monitoring System for Wind Turbines Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: the intelligent data processing of wind turbines (WT) data under the Internet of Things network will be studied from the aspects of information space definition, information quantization and data fusion method. In order to solve the vibration analysis on the specific location of wind turbine drive chain is not sensitive to early fault defects and unable to identify the fault defects problem, the acoustic emission (AE) technology is introduced into the typical wind turbine vibration monitoring system. Combined with Vibration-AE technology, used the Asset Condition Monitoring system for Wind Turbines (ACM-WT) running status information of the WT shafting were collected and analyzed. Using PCI2 data analysis software to collect information transmission system for processing, in order to identify early fault defect information of wind turbine drive chain.

articleTitle: Optimization and Implementation of TPC Decoding Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This TPC is an excellent method of error correcting code. It has the advantages of low decoding complexity and small decoding delay. Approximate optimal performance can be obtained at low SNR. This paper discusses the application and design method and implementation of TPC decoding technology in telemetry system. The optimization method and improvement of TPC decoding are described, and the improvement measures are put forward. Through simulation and testing, it is proved that the improvement measures have improved the decoding efficiency and improved the channel gain brought by the algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on Stress Characteristics of Dry-Type Cable Termination Bending Operation
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: For the present stage of the project more practical application of 110kV Bo-shaped down lead cable arrangement, cable terminal different bending angle stress distribution was simulated based on finite element numerical simulation, and determine the impact of the bending angle on the uneven distribution of the terminal internal stress to provide reference for the determination of practical engineering cable terminal bending angle. The results showed that: Under the arrangement of 110kV Bo-shaped down lead cable, when the cable terminal bending angle of less than 5°, each layer of stress distribution is within the scope of its tensile strength, the safe and stable operation of the dry-type cable terminal can be ensured.

articleTitle: Prognostic Research for the Dynamic Processes and Load Characteristics of Spacecraft
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: On the background of Lunar unmanned sampling and Mars exploration, the working modes are getting bigger in numbers and classes, and the functions needed to support are also becoming more. Such as the docking mechanisms in the process of Rendezvous and Docking, antenna or camera pointing parts used in Lunar or Mars observation, thermal control caused by space temperature alternation, SSPA or TWTA operations for the communication between earth and lunar. It has been proved that the operating characteristics for electromagnetic and mechanical moving parts show different kinds of figures in data value sets. Base on this, using multi-classsification and distance computation, the result of quantitative distance calculation of different data sets got in different life period for the same working mode, can be used as the proof to demonstrate the health status for a specific mode.

articleTitle: Design of Drilling Sensor Information Management System Based on UHF RFID
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The existing drilling sensor information management adopts the traditional methods such as paper report, bar code and magnetic stripe recognition, unreliable and inefficient. The updated drilling sensor information management system can provide the data base and technical support for the management, maintenance and repair of the drilling sensor through the information of the sensor, such as RFID technology, data management, information network and so on. Improve the modern management level of drilling sensor information. This paper mainly introduces the structure of the system and its software design.

articleTitle: Pointing Error Analysis of Star Sensor on GEO Satellite
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: For geostationary communication satellites, the measurement precision of high accuracy star sensor is an important factor which affects the pointing accuracy of the satellite. Using on-orbit data from the star sensors on different positions of the satellite, we find that the variation of star sensor pointing error is related to the variation of the orbit thermal environment. We compare the thermal deformation simulation result of the installation structure of the star sensor and the on-orbit data. These two agree with each other on the direction and the magnitude of error variation. The conclusion is that the periodical thermal deformation of the star sensor installation structure is the main factor affecting its accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Faulted Prediction Method of Marine Gyroscope Based on GT-RVM
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Marine gyroscope is an important guarantee for the safety and reliability of ships. Aiming at the issue of fault prediction technique of marine gyroscope, a method based on grey theory (GT) and relevance vector machine (RVM) for the prediction of marine gyroscope was proposed. After analyzing the failure mode of gyroscope in marine inertial navigation system, the random drift data was extracted as the characteristic parameter of the fault. Considering the randomness, nonlinearity, non-stationary and weak time variability of random drift data, the relevance vector machine was used to predict the fault. The accumulative generating operation (AGO) and inverse accumulated generating operation (IAGO) were used to process the original data. To improve the accuracy of the long term prediction of the RVM, the grey relational analysis is used to update the RVM model dynamically. The experimental results show that the proposed method can trace the characteristic parameters' trend and can be effectively applied in fault prediction of marine gyroscope.

articleTitle: A Method of Extracting Submerged Periodic Impulse-Response Based on Fractional Dual Tree Complex Wavelet Transform with Matching Pursuit and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: It is a matter of great significance how to extract incipient and hidden fault feature from heavy noise. Extracting submerged periodic impact signal is one of important approach to fault diagnosis. Bearing failure is one of the most common reasons of machine breakdowns and accidents. Based on Matching Pursuit in dual fractional Fourier-wavelet domain, a novel method is proposed to extract the fault characteristic frequency for the incipient fault diagnosis of rolling element bearings in this paper. It is carried out in two steps. First, the fractional Fourier Transform and dual tree complex wavelet transform are implemented according to the criteria of the periodicity of its autocorrelation function to achieve maximum. Secondly, matching pursuit method in dual fractional Fourier-wavelet domain is applied to extracting submerged periodic signal. Taking orthogonal wavelet bases that mutually form Hilbert transform pairs as choice object, the method can match feature more effectively by a set of elementary functions of these dual orthogonal wavelets. From the theoretical analysis and the experimental studies, it is shown that the proposed method is effective especially to extract impulsive feature of the defects impacts on high intensity noise for a roller bearing system, while other matching pursuit method based on DWT and other wavelet de-noising methods based on threshold cannot do it completely. The effectiveness of the proposed method has been demonstrated by both simulation and experimental data.

articleTitle: Research of Inertial Instrument Error Identification Algorithm for Spacecraft Test
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The inertial instrument is the important part of spacecraft control system, its measurement precision is related to the control precision and service life of the spacecraft. During the testing process of spacecraft, the key point is to obtain accurate model of the actual system. In order to identify the actual inertial navigation system error model from test data, a new identification method is proposed. Through the reverse process of strapdown inertial navigation, the ideal inertial instrument output data can be solved from navigation result. The error compensation system can be established, with ideal data input and the actual data of the inertial instrument output. Finally, the error model and error coefficient of inertial instrument can be obtained with the system identification method. The test results show that the method is effective and has reference value and directing significance for engineering application.

articleTitle: Asymmetric Redundancy: An Enhanced Redundancy Strategy for MLC NAND Flash Memory Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: For Multi-Level Cell (MLC) NAND flash, which is a main-stream product with two bits per cell, redundancy method has been widely adopted to enhance the reliability of the system data. In particular, it is used to enhance metadata reliability because the damage of metadata may cause the system to crash and a large amount of data to be lost. However, for MLC NAND flash with asymmetric distribution of bit errors between least significant bit (LSB) pages and most significant bit (MSB) pages, the arbitrary distribution strategy for replicas of the traditional redundancy method will degrade of effectiveness of the redundancy method. This paper presents Asymmetric Redundancy method, an enhanced redundancy strategy for MLC NAND flash memory storage systems. Our technique for the first time exploits the property of the multi-page architecture of MLC NAND flash memory to change the allocation of metadata and its replicas. We can achieve much more reliable storage system compared with traditional redundancy methods. We have implemented Asymmetric Redundancy on a real hardware platform. The experimental results show that Asymmetric Redundancy can reduce uncorrectable page errors by up to 98.33% and 81.13% compared to baseline and Meta-Cure, respectively.

articleTitle: Longitudinal Control and Airwake Suppression Algorithm for Carrier-Based Aircraft Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Compared with landing on a fixed runway, carrier landing faces with more difficulties and higher risk, such as shorter runway, pitching decks and high relative velocity. What's more, the carrier airwake further deteriorates the situation, which causes aircraft trajectory deviation from reference landing path, and the risk of waving off or colliding with the carrier. Carrier landing safety is therefore seriously affected. Aiming at this problem, on the basis of modelling the small-disturbance motion equation of a carrier-based aircraft under the landing status, the article presented a flight control and airwake rejection algorithm based on state space model predictive control(MPC), in which the airwake models were considered. The computer simulation experiments indicated that the proposed method could effectively suppress the disturbance of carrier airwake, and improve the landing accuracy significantly.

articleTitle: Research on Bird Habitat Discovery Based on DBSCAN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Bird activity has a close relationship with human life and has attracted an increasing attention. However, it has encountered many problems such as great limitations on research methods, low data utilization rate, statistics-focused and ineffective data processing and so on. In this paper, a new algorithm to find bird habitat based on DBSCAN algorithm-migration pattern mining (MPM) algorithm is proposed. Results show that MPM algorithm can deal with data efficiently and has the ability to find habitats of migratory birds scientifically.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of the Virtual Atmospheric Environment in Near Space
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In recent years, the virtual test has played an important role in development and testing of more and more aircraft for its unique advantages. Near space is the transit area between aerospace and aviation, and it has a significant impact on the safety and accurate entry of the rockets and other variable aircraft. Therefore, a method of constructing virtual atmospheric environment in near space was put forward, which was based on the statistical feature model and SEDRIS standard with the data from SABER detector of American TIMED satellite. Based on the Construction software of virtual atmospheric environment in near space, the data of the corresponding space-time range and resolution could be generated by the user-defined setup, and the data could be normalized according to the SEDRIS specification to generate the adjacent space atmosphere according to the SEDRIS standard environmental data.

articleTitle: Research on Visual Detection and Control System of Three Axis Servo Dispensing Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to place the parts and components accurately on the printed board or workpiece surface, a fully automatic three axis motion detection and control system based on machine vision is built. Image preprocessing can be conducted in visual software, after image is acquired by visual camera, and then the coordinates of the center points of the workpiece can be obtained by geometric template matching. A fixed-point method for calibration of magnification and offset of visual inspection system is put forward, which realizes the transformation of image coordinate to physical coordinate, to control the movement of three axis platform by motion controller. The system realizes the function of three axis glue dispensing. Through repeated tests and statistical verification, the repeated positioning precision is 0.03mm, which meets the requirements of industrial production.

articleTitle: The Design and Simulation of Coting's Thermal Shock Resistance System
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The spacecraft is repeatedly in and out of shadow during service, and the engine nozzle is repeatedly sprayed with flame and cooled heat cycle. This kind of long-term heat cycle can cause degradation of coating material performance, and the coating surface produce black spot, crack, and then fall off. This phenomenon is called thermal shock. The thermal shock resistance of the spray coating material is a very important index. The precise control and testing of temperature is an important aspect for the test system of thermal shock resistance of coatings. In the paper, an accurate temperature control method for thermal shock test system for thermal shock of coating is presented. PLC is the main controller, and the colorimetric pyrometer is used to make real-time temperature measurement. Thyristor controlled heating power can control the temperature, and LabVIEW software is used to simulate PID temperature control of heating link. The temperature curve and the power percentage change curve of the simulated results show that the selected parameter is good for temperature control.

articleTitle: Analysis on Remainder Activation Effect of PIND Impact Test Conditions for Sealed Relay
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Particle Impact Noise Detection is one of the most important methods in detecting remainders within relays before they put into use. The activation effect of relay remainders is the core attribute for PIND impact test condition, and it can directly affect the detection success rate. This paper analyzes the restraint model of relay remainders, and then presents an analysis method on impact activation process based on finite element simulation. Meanwhile, the influence of the impact test condition on the activation effect is also analyzed, and the key factors influencing the activation effect in impact test condition are given.

articleTitle: Spacecraft Design Method Based on Knowledge Engineering
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to meet the challenge of spacecraft innovation design and its knowledge inheritance and effective application, explore knowledge management for spacecraft overall design, breakthrough knowledge-driven spacecraft collaborative design, evaluation methods and multidisciplinary full-flow spacecraft design knowledge base construction technology, this paper describes a set of spacecraft design methods based on knowledge engineering.

articleTitle: Research on the Solution of Knowledge Base System for Small and Medium Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With the development of the times, the knowledge base system has gradually become the mainfocus of the information construction of enterprises, institutions and groups. This paper first studies the concept, value, service object and service content of knowledge base system. Furthermore, it provides the basis for understanding and positioning of small and medium-sized enterprises about knowledge base system, and then carry on a comprehensive study on the mainstream knowledge base. Finally, the thesis puts forward some solutions of this, and analyses the key problems in depth.

articleTitle: A Novel Quadrupole Mass Filter Based on Rectangular Electrodes
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A low cost and simple geometry quadrupole mass filter was developed, in which rectangular electrodes were employed instead of traditional hyperboloid or cylindrical electrodes. Modeling and simulation were accomplished in COMSOL Multiphysics. The results showed that the performance of novel quadrupole mass filter turned out to be acceptable. For the low cost, simple geometry and easy to be assembled, it had a great prospect in the field of miniature, portable and low-level mass spectrometer.

articleTitle: Online Evaluation Method of Metering Device Running State Based on Similarity
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: For 10kv integrated metering device, only cyclical replacement of the electricity meter will not guarantee the efficient and accurate operation of the metering device. However, for the overall integrated metering box disassembly there are some problems, such as large quantity of work and difficulties in determining the substitution cycle. In this paper, through the online measurement of dynamic load variation parameters of power grid, the problems of dynamic trend change of electric energy is transformed into the problem of pattern distance in space. And then use dynamic time warping algorithm for similarity recognition of sequence patterns to determine the power similarity level. The comprehensive evaluation of the running state of the integrated electric energy metering device is realized. The results of laboratory test data proved the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Optimization and Application of the Transport Cost Model under the Transfer Supply System in Logistics Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: High transport cost has always been a major problem faced by Chinese logistics enterprises. Based on the actual cargo transport of logistics enterprises and under the premise of the scientific hypothesis, related contents of the mathematical model are used and transport costs are taken into an important factor affecting the operation of enterprises. Based on related data of a certain logistics service company and with the mathematical model, the company's transport routes are re-planned to achieve efficient and standardized logistics transport.

articleTitle: Research on Topology Inference Method for Ad Hoc Network Simulation on Exata
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Exata has excellent performance in wireless communication, but in the process of Ad Hoc network simulation, it can not realize the inference and visualization of network topology. In this paper, we analyze the AODV protocol, and use the information contained in the RREP message to realize the inference of the network topology. The experimental results prove the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: A Novel Lead-Acid Battery Equalization Circuit Based on Multiple Planar Transformers
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Due to the defects in the producing procedure, series storage battery inevitably presents inconsistency. When being charged, high voltage battery of battery pack is easy to be overcharged; when being discharged, low voltage battery of battery pack is easy to be excessively operated. As the charge-discharge cycle of storage battery pack continuously increases, the inconsistency is also increased, which would greatly shorten the battery lifetime. In this work, a novel battery equalization circuit was realized to dynamically adjust the battery energy. This circuit could significantly reduce the inconsistency of a battery pack.

articleTitle: Research on the Improvement of K-Nearest Neighbor Classifier for Imbalanced Text Categorization
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Some of the most widely used text classification methods, such as the K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) algorithm, the Native Bayes (NB) algorithm and the Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm, in terms of the good performance in balanced data classification, have performed poorly in imbalanced data classification. To solve this problem, many researchers have come up with their solutions, we also propose a new method to improve the performance of K-Nearest Neighbor classifier on imbalanced classification. In this paper, we combines K-Nearest Neighbor classifier with a new feature selection method called NFS, improved Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE) and Tomek Links Under-sampling Technique. The experimental results demonstrate that the improved method has a significant improvement on the classification efficiency of the bias dataset in the K-Nearest Neighbor classifier.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Image Restoration Based on Wiener Filter and RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: During image acquisition, remote sensing images are subject to a variety of degradations. Wiener filter is widely used method for remote sensing image restoration. To overcome the power spectrum ratio's evaluation problem of traditional Wiener filter methods, a remote sensing image restoration algorithm based on Wiener filter and RBF (Radial Basis Function) neural network is proposed. The algorithm adopts Wiener filter to recover the degraded remote sensing image. And the power spectrum ratio of the image is calculated by the RBF neural network. To reduce the calculating time, this paper proposes a matrix factorization algorithm to realize matrix's parallel arithmetic. Experimentations demonstrate that the proposed algorithm could acquire satisfactory remote sensing image recovering results. And the processing time could be controlled in a relatively short time.

articleTitle: A Calculating Method for the Focusing Cam Machining Error of the Aero-Remote Sensor
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: To solve the problem of machining error caused by the analytical method of focusing cam of aeronautical remote sensor, a new method of cam processing error calculation based on dichotomy is proposed. Firstly, the analytic design method of disc-shaped direct-acting roller cam is given according to the motion law of cam mechanism, and the coordinate determination formula of theoretical cam profile and actual machining cam outline is established. Then, the coordinates are determined by the coordinate measuring machine, and the mathematical model of processing error of each point in the cam contour is established. Finally, the mathematical model of machining error in MATLAB is realized, and a direct drive roller cam in the focusing mechanism of an aviation remote sensor is taken as an example to verify this new method. The experimental data shows that the maximum machining error of the cam profile points can satisfy the requirement of the focusing cam error well. Being simple and reliable, the algorithm can be used as an effective basis for judging whether disc-shaped direct-acting roller cams meet the requirements of error.

articleTitle: Social Network Behavior-Oriented Audio Steganography Scheme
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Social network, such as, Facebook, Twitter, Microblog, and WeChat, has millions of users, many of which have happily combined these sites and their daily practices. The social network platforms above support their users to connect with each other based on shared interests, political views, or other activities. Therefore, social networks will be a big market which can be explored and exploited for steganography. In this paper, according to social network behavior, we proposed an audio steganography scheme based on the time length of WeChat voice message, which utilizes the time length of voice message to represent the secret information. Based on such a social network behavior-sending a specific length of voice message, the secret message is successfully sent to the receiver secretly. Qualitative analyses show that our method has a good ability to resist statistical analysis and fault tolerance. The result of experiment indicates that the sender and the receiver can complete the transmission of secret information in a WeChat group. Although our method is simple with low capacity, it may open a new window for social network behavior-based steganography research.

articleTitle: A Transfer k-NN Classifier with the Bagging Method
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The k-nearest neighbors algorithm is a simple but an effective method in pattern recognition. The classic k-NN classifier is under the assumption that the training dataset and testing dataset are derived from the same dataset and exhibit the identical distribution. However, transfer learning relaxes these two assumptions and applies the knowledge from the related but different source domain to the target domain. In this paper, a transfer k-NN classification, which can be applied in transfer learning, is proposed. Firstly, the distribution discrepancy between the source domain and the target domain is reduced by reweighting the samples of the source domain. Then, a bagging method with the k-NN algorithm is designed to reduce the influence of the source domain for its massive sample size. Experimental results with the real-world dataset demonstrate that the proposed algorithm is more effective than the classical k-NN and the SVM algorithm.

articleTitle: High Precision Measurement Technology of Aircraft Navigation Ground Simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: High precision measurement technology of aircraft ground simulation is essential to achieve successful capture and brake of deep space aircraft. In this essay, monocular and binocular schemes based on computer vision are adopted respectively to realize the position and attitude measurement of the ground simulation system. The two-dimensional position information of the marking points is first extracted from the image. After that, the three-dimensional imaging model is developed to acquire the three-dimensional positions of the marking points based on their two-dimensional information. Then attitude measurement model is established, so the rotation angle and displacement of the motion simulator could be solved. Finally, the semi-physical simulation analysis is carried out for analysis and optimization of the measurement model.

articleTitle: Ship Tracking with Static Electric Field Based on Kalman-Type Filters
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Static Electric Field (SE) of ship has obvious distribution characteristics, and contains location information, which can be used to track the ship. The paper studies the feasibility to track ship using SE signal. First The state space model of ship motion is established; Ship SE signal is built by point current method? Linearly constraint is added to the state variables. The advantages and disadvantages of the classical Kalman filters in electric field tracking are compared by simulation. Simulation demonstrates the feasibility of tracking ship through using SE signal and the applicability of the traditional Kalman filters.

articleTitle: A Cognitive Period Optimization Algorithm Based on Interference Compensation Pricing
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper puts forward dynamic spectrum access in cognitive networks. Dynamic spectrum access is the key approach in a cognitive radio network which is adopted by a cognitive radio user to access the radio spectrum opportunistically. The interference caused by cognitive user in spectrum accessing process is a problem which can be studied. In this paper, a cognitive period optimization algorithm based on interference compensation pricing algorithm is proposed. The cognitive period optimization algorithm based on interference compensation pricing enables primary user to adjust the cognitive period according to the spectrum utilization of primary user. Moreover, the tradeoff between the interference probability for cognitive user and the channel idle probability is considered. Finally, some simulation results are given. The cognitive period optimization algorithm based on the interference compensation pricing can adjust the value of the cognitive period according to the spectrum utilization ratio of the primary user.

articleTitle: A Design Approach of Mitigating Single Event Upset for On-Chip Memory Based on SoC FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: To solve the problem of dual-core communication error in SoC FPGA which caused by SEUs (Single Event Upset) for space applications, an approach of OCM (On-Chip Memory) reinforcement for mitigating SEUs is designed in this paper. Combined the Software EDAC (Software-Implemented Error Detection and Correction) technology using Hsiao code and the hardware resource of SGI (Software Generated Interrupt) in Zynq-7000, the design approach has the capability to correct the single-bit error and detect the double-bit error when CPUs access OCM. Furthermore, dual-core processors can write back to OCM synchronously when single bit error occurred. The verification result shows that the design approach has the advantages of low delay, high reliability and flexible design. Also, it can avoid the conflict of data write-back when the dual-core processors access OCM. The design approach makes full use of on-chip resources, it has no requirement of additional hardware resources to improve the capability of mitigating SEUs for dualcore communication in SoC FPGA.

articleTitle: Design of the Auto-Test System of Signal Conditioning Module
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper aims to study the development and design of the automatic test system of signal conditioning module for the purpose of satisfying the teaching demonstration needs of automatic test system course experiment. This test platform is mainly composed of LXI instruments and signal conditioning module as the measured object. The design of this automatic test system mainly includes the design of the signal adapter board, the design of the user application, and the debugging of the overall system. It is verified that the system is able to test the signal conditioning module automatically. On the other hand, the automatic test system can also serve as an example of teaching demonstration, which is meet requirements of the project.

articleTitle: Design of a New Adaptive Controller for Synchronization of Fractional-Order Chaotic Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, for the synchronization of fractional order chaotic systems, based on Mittag-Leffler stability theory, a new adaptive control scheme is established. In the case of no eliminating the nonlinear part, the controller is designed with linear controller and adaptive controller. The simulation of the synchronization several chaotic systems was conducted by the adaptive controller which effectively restrain chattering and ensure the smooth. The simulation results verify the validity and feasibility of the controller.

articleTitle: The Application of EKF in Parameter Identification of State-Space Model
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: State-space model is an efficient tool for describing multiple input multiple output system, but the parameters identification of state-space model is a complicated problem, because in many cases, the parameters and state variables are all unknown in the model. Aiming at the shortcomings of the traditional identification method, in this paper, combined the unknown parameters and state variables of the state space model into a new state variable, then the linear state space model equation can be transformed into a nonlinear equation, and extended Kalman filtering(EKF) algorithm is used to estimate the new state variables. In this way, we can implement double estimates of the unknown parameters and state variables. Doing simulation and analysis with Matlab, the results show that the method can realize parameter identification and state estimation of state-space model effectively, which has higher precision and accuracy.

articleTitle: Channel Access Scheduling for Wireless Network Coding Operation in Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Network coding can significantly improves the performance of wireless networks. How to encode more packets in the intermediate node is a critical design issue. In this paper, we proposed a revised Time Division Multiple Address (TDMA) protocol to adapt network coding operation in wireless ad hoc networks. The proposed protocol efficiently and evenly assigns slot to each node in the network. The performance of the network is improved by reducing unsigned slot and balancing slot distribution among nodes. More available packets can be encoded in the intermediate node when operating network coding. The simulation result shown that, compared with DCF protocol, the proposed protocol obtained better performance. In the end of the paper, we discussed the unsolved problems.

articleTitle: Attitude Determination for Land Vehicles Based on Low Cost GPS/MEMS-IMU
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Attitude determination is essential for navigation of land vehicles, but the inertial sensors used for attitude estimation are susceptible to environmental disturbance. In this paper, vibrational influences on inertial sensors are analyzed. A method to use single-antenna GPS for pseudo-attitude estimation is presented. Then, an extended Kalman filter is proposed for data fusion. Results shown that the proposed method can determine attitude with vibration on land vehicles and estimate the acceleration well, compared with the complementary filters.

articleTitle: Edge Router Design of Energy Consumption Devices for Large Building
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: To monitor the energy consumption of a large building is quite important nowdays. An edge router is designed in this paper in order that the monitoring terminal can access the energy consumption data of large building in real time. The energy consumption devices in large buildings can be connected to the Internet through the edge router. The STM32F4 chip is used as the hardware processor of the edge router. The Free Real Time Operating System (FREERTOS) combining the 6in4 technique is employed as the software platform of the edge router. An address-mapping table is designed to improve the efficiency of data transferring. The experimental results show that energy consumption devices can obtain the energy consumption feedback within 100ms. The max transferring speed of data reaches 10M/S, which satisfy the real-time requirement of data accessing in most situations.

articleTitle: Spacecraft Verification Environment – A Data-Driven and Model-Based Hybrid Spacecraft Testing Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Spacecraft testing is an important activity during the design and implementation of all space missions. Efficient organization and advanced tools can save large time and money spent on testing of spacecraft's software and hardware function. Model based approach has become a very promising solution in spacecraft testing area. Well-designed model-based methods and tools can help reduce costs while increase software and hardware quality at the same time. Based on long term spacecraft testing data, this paper presents a data-driven and model-based spacecraft testing simulation system. The novel simulation system can generate typical testing model by extracting historical testing data, and the formed testing model is able to interact with the existing spacecraft testing system to achieve close-loop simulation. In addition, various numeric model of different spacecraft's subsystems can also be incorporated into the simulation system. In this way, both on-board software and hand-written test case can be verified in early stage, which improves the testing quality and boosts manufacture progress.

articleTitle: The Design and Research of Urban Intelligent Traffic Controller Based on ARM
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Traffic congestion and road congestion have become an important issue in many countries, so the development of intelligent transportation system is an important strategy to solve the problem of traffic congestion. Firstly introduce the intelligent transportation concept as well as the domestic and foreign situation in this paper. A traffic light intelligent controller is designed based on ARM920T embedded microprocessor S3C2410A combining with radio frequency identification (RFID) technology and embedded technology. This paper emphatically expounds the hardware design of intelligent traffic lights controller, the design principle of lighting scheme, lighting strategy and software realization method, which provide the theoretical basis for the realization of intelligent traffic signal control.

articleTitle: The Simulation and Probing Technique of Large-Scale Plasma in Atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2018 Eighth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Large-scale plasma in the atmosphere is thermodynamic system which is made up of ions, atoms, molecules and particulate matter. The plasma which has the characteristics of thermal movement and electromagnetic interaction can be used to signal interference, invisibility and wireless communication.
